translations.처음 하는 일은 동료와 함께 확인해 주세요. 모르는 점이나 위험한 상황은: Check unfamiliar work together with a colleague. It is okay to ask immediately about anything you do not understand or any dangerous situation.
translations.홀·주방이 있는 소규모 한식 매장. 기존 영업시간·파트·크루는 유지하며,: A small Korean restaurant with a hall and kitchen. The existing business hours, parts, and crew will be maintained, and prices, refunds, recipes, and hygiene figures will follow actual store data.
translations.버디와 주방 둘러보기: Take a tour of the kitchen with Buddy
translations.사람과 공간부터 익혀요: Let’s learn about people and space first.
Say hello to Minji and find the work area, storage area, and emergency exit together.
translations.내가 일할 위치와 이동 동선을 설명해 봐요. 낯선 장비는 사용 전에 물어: Explain where I will work and my route of movement. Ask about unfamiliar equipment before using it.
I know what I will do today and who to ask for help.
translations.시작하기 전에 함께 확인해요: Let’s check together before we start.
translations.매장의 손 씻기, 복장, 식재료 구분과 알레르기 정보 확인 방법을 보여: Ask them to show you how to wash your hands, what to wear, how to distinguish ingredients, and check allergy information at the store.
translations.매장에서 정한 위생 절차를 함께 따라 해요. 식재료나 알레르기 정보가 불: We follow the hygiene procedures established by the store. If you are unsure about ingredients or allergy information, stop and ask.
I know the store’s hygiene procedures and how to check when I don’t know.
translations.시범을 보고 옆에서 따라 해요: Watch the demonstration and follow along.
translations.수거부터 세척·건조·보관까지 매장의 순서를 봐요. 뜨거운 기구, 깨진 식: Look at the order of the store, from collection to washing, drying, and storage. Also check handling of hot utensils, broken dishes, and detergents.
translations.민지님이 지켜보는 동안 식기 한 묶음을 처리해요. 세제나 장비 설정은 안: While Minji watches, I process a bundle of dishes. Use detergent and equipment settings after receiving guidance.
I've been through a cycle with you and I know when you need help.
translations.오늘 맡을 간단한 작업 하나: One simple task to take on today
translations.오늘 맡길 재료 준비 한 가지를 보여 달라고 해요. 도구, 분량, 보관과: I ask you to show me one of the ingredients you will be entrusted with today. Check the tools, quantities, storage and display methods.
translations.같은 작업을 소량으로 함께 해봐요. 칼이나 장비는 설명과 감독을 받은 범: Try doing the same task together in small quantities. Use knives and equipment only within the scope of instruction and supervision.
We knew the scope of work we could do today and checked the first results together.
translations.모르면 멈추고 짧게 물어봐요: If you don't know, stop and ask briefly.
translations.일을 마쳤을 때, 도움이 필요할 때, 위험을 봤을 때 알리는 방법을 확인: Find out how to notify them when work is completed, when help is needed, and when danger is encountered.
translations.“이 작업 끝났어요”, “다음 단계 같이 봐 주세요”를 말해봐요. 급한: Say “I’m done with this task,” or “Please take a look at the next steps together.” In case of urgent danger, we notify you right on the spot.
I practiced how to ask my buddy for help.
translations.첫 근무 준비 확인: Check your readiness for your first shift
Let’s talk briefly about things we’ve done together and things that are still difficult.
translations.다음 업무와 근무 시간을 확인해요. 계속 함께해야 하는 일과 맡을 수 있: Check the next task and working hours. Your buddy decides what tasks you must continue to do together and what tasks you can take on.
I asked my questions and was ready to start the next task with Buddy.
translations.인수인계에서 바뀐 일 찾기 · 담당과 도움받을 사람 확인: Find out what has changed during handover and check who is in charge and who will receive help
translations.외식 공통 · 첫 매장의 해당 작업을 하는 사업장. 현장 절차와 장비 지: Common to eating out · A business that performs the corresponding work of the first store. Adapt to site procedures and equipment guidelines.
translations.공개 자료를 참고한 편집 제안 · 현장 검토 필요: Editing suggestions based on public data · On-site review required
translations.출처별 관할 · 운영 참고: Jurisdiction and operation reference by source
translations.기존 위키 조사 자료 · 업무 구조 참고, 국내 법적 기준으로 단정하지: Reference to existing wiki research data and work structure, not determined based on domestic legal standards
translations.오늘 품절·예약·미완료 업무를 읽고 본인 업무에 영향을 주는 항목을 하나: Read today's sold-out items, reservations and unfinished work, and identify each item affecting your work.
Check the date first so you do not mistake yesterday's notes for today's notice.
translations.담당과 도움받을 사람 확인: Confirm responsibilities and who can help
translations.빈 근무 시간과 오늘 버디를 확인하고 모르는 업무를 누구에게 물을지 정해: Check uncovered shift times and today's buddy, and decide whom to ask about unfamiliar work.
Agree on responsibilities before starting equipment work you cannot do alone.
translations.내 구역을 한 바퀴 돌고 부족한 준비를 담당자에게 직접 알려요. 인수인계: Walk around your area and tell the responsible person directly about missing preparations. Confirm the handover is complete.
Reading the notes is different from finishing the preparations.
translations.전처리 도구와 작업대 준비: Prepare food-prep tools and work surfaces
translations.원물과 완성식품 구역 나누기 · 작업대 세척 후 준비: Separate raw food and finished food areas · Clean and prepare the work surface
translations.원물과 완성식품 구역 나누기: Separate raw ingredients and ready-to-eat food areas
Prepare raw and ready-to-eat ingredients with separate containers and tools, and check labels.
Check each tool's purpose rather than relying only on its color.
translations.작업대 세척 후 준비: Clean the work surface before preparing
translations.찌꺼기와 오염을 먼저 제거하고 매장 제품 지침대로 세척·소독해요. 필요한: Remove debris and contamination first, then clean and sanitize according to the store product instructions. Check the required contact time and rinsing.
Do not finish by merely spraying sanitizer onto a dusty surface.
translations.오늘 사용할 양만 소분: Portion only the amount needed today
translations.예상 주문과 레시피에 맞춰 소분하고 재료명·준비 시각·사용 기준을 표시해: Portion according to expected orders and recipes; label the ingredient name, preparation time and use criteria.
Check remaining stock before deciding additional prep quantities to avoid duplicate preparation.
translations.설거지 구역 정리 확인: Check the dishwashing area is organized
translations.사용 식기와 깨끗한 식기 분리 · 세척 결과와 건조 확인: Separate used and clean dishes and check washing results and drying
Empty food scraps and arrange dishes so dirty and clean dish routes do not cross.
Do not return clean dishes to a dirty basket.
translations.매장 세척기·세제 지침대로 처리한 뒤 음식물과 세제 잔여를 확인하고 지정: Follow the store dishwasher and detergent instructions, check for food and detergent residue, then place dishes on the designated drying rack.
Check that moisture is not trapped between stacked dishes.
translations.배수망과 바닥 정리: Clear drain strainers and tidy the floor
translations.배수망 찌꺼기를 수거하고 도구를 제자리에 둬요. 물기를 정리한 뒤 통로를: Collect debris from drain strainers and return tools to their places. Clear moisture before opening the passage.
Do not finish by placing only a warning sign on a wet floor.
translations.손 씻기와 위생복·위생모 착용 · 몸 상태 말하기: Wash your hands, wear sanitary clothing and a sanitary hat, and talk about your physical condition.
translations.뼈찜·감자탕 전문점의 해당 작업을 하는 사업장. 현장 절차와 장비 지침에: A business establishment that carries out the relevant work for a bone stew and gamjatang specialty restaurant. Adapt to site procedures and equipment guidelines.
translations.뼈찜·감자탕 전문점: Bone stew and gamjatang specialty restaurant
translations.방문 후기 S19·S25~S29의 제공 사례 비교와 공개 위생 자료를 참:
Comparison of cases provided in visit reviews S19·S25~S29 and editorial suggestions based on public hygiene data.
Store recipes, current menus, and delivery methods require review by the person in charge.
translations.손 씻기와 위생복·위생모 착용: Wash hands and put on hygienic clothing and a hair covering
translations.탈의 후 비누로 30초 이상 손을 씻고 매장 위생복·위생모(주방은 마스크: After changing, wash hands with soap for at least 30 seconds and wear the store's hygienic clothing and hair covering (a mask in the kitchen). Cover hand wounds with waterproof dressings and gloves, and tell the supervisor.
translations.앞치마를 화장실까지 입고 가지 않아요. 휴대폰을 만졌으면 다시 손을 씻어: Do not wear your apron into the toilet. Wash hands again after touching your phone.
translations.설사·구토·발열·인후통이 있으면 조리·배식 전에 사장님이나 매니저에게 먼: Tell the owner or manager before cooking or serving if you have diarrhea, vomiting, fever or a sore throat. The owner maintains records of health examinations 1 time a year (typhoid, paratyphoid and pulmonary tuberculosis).
Store rules require reporting illness, rather than working through it.
translations.마감 메모에서 품절 재료, 남은 육수·초벌 등뼈 양, 예약, 고장 난 장: Check closing notes for sold-out ingredients, remaining broth and parboiled pork spine quantities, reservations and broken equipment; identify what affects your work.
Check the date first. It is easy to mistake yesterday's notes for today's situation.
translations.오픈·피크·마감 담당과 오늘 버디를 확인해요. 혼자 하기 어려운 육수 솥: Check who handles opening, peak hours and closing, and today's buddy. Assign responsibility before starting broth-pot or burner work that is difficult to do alone.
Asking before unfamiliar work is the quickest way to proceed.
translations.오픈 · 홀과 셀프바 준비: Opening: prepare dining area and self-service station
translations.간판·조명·냉난방 켜고 안내문 확인 · 테이블 세팅: Turn on signs, lighting, heating and cooling, check notices, and set tables.
translations.간판·조명·냉난방 켜고 안내문 확인: Switch on signage, lighting and climate control; check notices
translations.간판과 홀 조명, 냉난방을 켜요. 출입문의 영업시간(11:30~22:00: Switch on signage, dining-area lights and heating or air conditioning. Check that entrance notices clearly show business hours (11:30~22:00), break time (14:00~16:00, excluding weekends) and last orders at 21:30.
Missing notices mean twice as much explaining to customers.
translations.테이블마다 휴지·물티슈·앞접시 받침·뼈 버리는 통을 놓고 의자를 정렬해요: Put tissues, wet wipes, side-plate stands and bone-disposal containers on each table; align chairs. Check a trivet is present where a hot pot will be placed.
Sticky table surfaces are easier to see under bright opening-time lighting than during closing.
translations.앞접시·국그릇·수저·집게를 채우고 밑반찬(매장 구성)을 반찬통에 담아 뚜: Stock side plates, soup bowls, cutlery and tongs. Put the store's side dishes into containers and cover them. Provide separate tongs for each dish and label the filling time.
Refill customer-served side dishes frequently in small amounts to reduce waste.
translations.소금·후추·양념통과 물 준비: Prepare salt, pepper, condiments and water
translations.셀프바 옆 소금·후추·다대기 통을 채우고 정수기·물병·컵을 확인해요. 뼈: Fill salt, pepper and spicy seasoning containers beside the self-service station; check the water dispenser, bottles and cups. Customers often use these seasonings with pork-bone soup.
Wash and dry salt shakers with blocked lid holes before refilling.
translations.매장 주차 공간의 장애물과 입구 바닥·유리를 정리해요. 우천 시 우산 꽂: Remove obstacles from the store's parking spaces and clean the entrance floor and glass. In rain, put out an umbrella stand and slip warning signs.
Tidy the entrance in the last 5 minutes before the first customers arrive.
translations.입고 등뼈 확인 · 핏물 빼기: Check the spine and remove blood.
translations.라벨의 부위·중량·입고일을 확인하고 색과 냄새가 정상인지 봐요. 이상하면: Check the cut, weight and arrival date on the label, and ensure color and smell are normal. If abnormal, do not use it; notify the owner with a photo.
Recording thawing start time for frozen pork spine helps calculate blood-soaking time.
translations.찬물(매장 레시피의 설탕물 여부)에 등뼈를 담가 매장 기준 시간 동안 핏: Soak pork spine in cold water (check whether the store recipe uses sugar water) for the store-specified time, changing the water during soaking. Mark the start time on the container.
translations.핏물이 덜 빠지면 육수가 탁하고 잡내가 나요. 시간을 눈대중으로 줄이지: Insufficient blood removal makes broth cloudy and unpleasant-smelling. Do not shorten the time by guesswork.
translations.끓는 물에 매장 향신채(월계수잎·통후추·생강·소주 등 레시피 기준)를 넣: Add the store recipe's aromatics (bay leaves, whole peppercorns, ginger, soju, etc.) to boiling water; parboil pork spine for the specified time and discard the water.
Never use the parboiling water as broth.
translations.흐르는 찬물에 뼈를 하나씩 헹궈 핏덩이·뼈가루·불순물을 제거해요. 씻은: Rinse each bone under running cold water to remove blood clots, bone dust and impurities. Put washed bones into a clean dedicated tray.
Do not mix tools used for raw bones with trays holding washed bones.
translations.소·중·대 기준 무게(매장 레시피)로 나눠 용기에 담고 재료명·소분 시각: Divide into small, medium and large portions by the store recipe's weights; label ingredient name, portioning time and use criteria, then refrigerate.
Use evening reservations and yesterday's sales to plan portions and reduce leftover bones.
translations.준비 · 육수와 기본 뼈곰탕 국물: Preparation: broth and basic pork-bone soup
translations.육수 솥 올리기 · 거품·기름 걷기와 불 조절: Raising the stock pot, adding foam and oil, and adjusting the heat
translations.솥의 물량과 초벌 등뼈·대파·마늘·생강 등 매장 레시피 재료를 확인하고: Check the water quantity, parboiled pork spine and recipe ingredients such as spring onion, garlic and ginger, then turn on the heat. Record the start time.
After opening the gas valve, stay until you confirm ignition.
translations.거품·기름 걷기와 불 조절: Skim foam and fat; adjust heat
translations.끓기 시작하면 거품과 기름을 걷고 매장 기준 화력으로 낮춰요. 물이 줄면: When boiling begins, skim foam and fat and lower heat to the store standard. If water decreases, top up only with hot water.
Cold water makes the soup cloudy and lengthens cooking time.
translations.오늘 주문에 제공할 식전 국물 종류와 품절 대체 기준을 담당자에게 확인해: Ask the responsible person which starter soup is served with today's orders and how to substitute sold-out items. Reviews mention pork-bone broth, bean-sprout soup and no starter soup; do not label it as included with every order.
Do not mix yesterday's soup left at the bottom of the warmer into fresh soup.
translations.어제 보관한 육수가 있으면 사장님·매니저에게 사용 여부를 확인받고, 승인: If stored broth from yesterday remains, ask the owner or manager whether it may be used; reheat and use only approved broth.
Do not decide to use it just because it smells acceptable.
translations.준비 · 양념·사리·사이드: Preparation: seasonings, add-ons and side dishes
translations.뼈찜 양념장 소분 · 특제소스 준비: Preparation of bone stew marinade and special sauce
translations.뼈찜 양념장 소분: Portion sauce for braised pork spine
translations.산뼈찜과 화산뼈찜의 오늘 판매 옵션·매운 단계와 매장 승인 양념 준비 기: Check today's San and Hwasan braised-pork-spine options, spice levels and approved sauce-preparation standards; label each container. Enter proportions and quantities only after the store recipe is finalized.
Distinguish similarly colored sauces by labels, not their locations.
translations.오늘 메뉴별 소스 제공 기준을 담당자에게 확인하고 종류별 준비분을 식별해: Ask the responsible person about today's sauce service for each menu item and identify each prepared batch. Reviews describe different sauces such as soy-mustard sauce for San and mayonnaise sauce for Hwasan braised pork spine; do not fix these as universal.
translations.소스 종류와 제공 여부를 주문별로 확인해요. 화산뼈찜에 마요소스가 제공된: Check sauce type and whether it is served for each order. Some reviews also describe mayonnaise sauce with Hwasan braised pork spine.
translations.사리·볶음밥 재료 확인: Check noodle add-ons and fried-rice ingredients
translations.오늘 판매하는 우동·칼국수사리와 계란볶음밥·식후 볶음밥을 구분해 준비분을: Check today's udon and kalguksu noodle add-ons, egg fried rice and after-meal fried rice separately. Confirm separate or combined noodle service and its timing against the order ticket and store standards.
translations.피크에 사리가 떨어지면 주문을 못 받아요. 준비 시간에 세는 것이 가장: Running out of noodle add-ons at peak time prevents taking orders. Counting during preparation is easiest.
translations.감자·우거지·채소 손질: Prepare potatoes, cabbage greens and vegetables
translations.감자·우거지(시래기)·콩나물·대파를 매장 레시피 크기로 손질해 용기에 담: Cut potatoes, cabbage greens (dried radish greens), bean sprouts and spring onions to the store recipe's sizes; put them into containers and label preparation times.
Use separate cutting boards for raw bones and vegetables.
translations.뼈찜 위에 꽂는 깃발 등 데코 소품과 집게·가위·앞접시 예비분을 배식대에: Stock serving counters with decorations such as flags placed on braised pork spine, plus spare tongs, scissors and side plates.
Replace wet or torn decorations immediately.
translations.주문표 읽기 · 뼈찜 조리: Reading the order sheet · Cooking steamed bones
translations.주문번호·테이블과 메뉴(산뼈찜·화산뼈찜·뼈곰탕·뼈짬뽕), 수량·사이즈·맵: Check the order number, table and menu (San or Hwasan braised pork spine, pork-bone soup or pork-bone spicy noodle soup), quantity, size, spice level, noodle/rice choice, add-ons, fried-rice type and exclusions.
Standardize order-ticket notation so portion size is not confused with party size.
translations.주문 메뉴와 사이즈·맵기·제외 요청을 준비분에 대조하고 매장 책임자가 승: Match the ordered menu, size, spice level and exclusions to prepared portions; confirm the cooking procedure and completion criteria approved by the store supervisor. Do not determine times, heat or ingredients from reviews alone.
Check cooking time, heat and doneness against the manual approved by the store supervisor.
translations.완성 확인과 마무리: Check the finished dish and final details
translations.본품과 주문표를 대조한 뒤 오늘 매장 기준에 맞는 동반 소스·국물·사리의: Match the main dish to the order ticket; confirm today's sauce, soup and noodle types and whether served separately or together. Reviews describe different service styles, so do not assume a single fixed method.
translations.우동사리가 별도로 나온 후기와 본품에 함께 나온 후기가 있어요. 오늘 기: Some reviews describe udon served separately and others together with the main dish. Check today's standard.
translations.계란볶음밥 추가 주문과 식후 볶음밥 요청을 별개 항목으로 확인해요. 실제: Treat additional egg fried rice orders and after-meal fried rice requests as separate items. Follow store standards for actual product relationships and cooking/service timing; coordinate order changes with the dining-area team.
After receiving an actual after-meal request, match the order number and table.
translations.완성된 냄비는 받침 위에 올려 배식대에 두고 홀에 콜해요. 냄비 손잡이와: Place the finished pot on a trivet at the serving counter and call the dining-area team. Check pot handles and broth overflow.

translations.재고와 사용 예정량, 입고 대기 주문을 함께 확인해요. 같은 품목을 중복: Check stock, planned use and orders awaiting arrival together. Compare units and quantities to avoid duplicate orders.
translations.공급처·규격·수량·납품 예정일을 확인하고 승인 권한에 맞춰 발주 요청을: Confirm supplier, specification, quantity and expected arrival date; pass requests according to approval authority. Distinguish demo orders in the app from actual supplier transmission.
translations.입고 확인 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedure used to confirm receipt and connect store conditions and standards
translations.실제 도착한 품목의 이름·규격·수량을 주문과 비교해요. 누락·오배송·파손: Compare actual arrivals' names, specifications and quantities to orders. Separately record shortages, wrong deliveries and damage; notify the responsible person.
translations.품목별 검수 기준에 따라 표시·보관 상태를 확인해요. 기준에 맞지 않거나: Check labels and storage condition against each item's inspection criteria. Do not use items that fail or are hard to assess; ask the responsible person before handling them. Store only checked items in designated places and record receipt.
translations.보관·재고 확인 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to check storage, inventory, and connect store conditions and standards
translations.품목별 지정 위치와 표시를 확인해요. 새 입고분과 기존 물품을 구분하고: Check each item's designated location and labels. Distinguish new arrivals from existing items and organize by store use order.
translations.대상 품목의 단위를 확인한 뒤 실물을 세어 기록해요. 수량 차이·표시 누: Check item units, count actual goods and record them. Tell the responsible person about discrepancies, missing labels or abnormal conditions. Follow inventory settings for checks after ordering.
translations.식재료 전처리·준비 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used in connection with food ingredient preprocessing, preparation, and store conditions and standards
translations.선택한 메뉴·재료의 매장 레시피와 준비량을 확인해요. 도구·작업 공간·사: Check store recipes and preparation quantities for selected menus/ingredients. Identify tools, workspace and supplies; if process standards are missing, ask the supervisor first.
translations.재료별 승인된 손질·해동·세척·소분 방법을 따라요. 사용한 재료와 준비: Follow approved preparation, thawing, washing and portioning methods for each ingredient. Label ingredients used and preparation status separately; move to specified storage.
translations.준비량·남은 작업·이상 사항을 다음 담당에게 전달해요. 실제 준비량은 준: Tell the next person prepared quantities, remaining work and issues. Compare actual prepared quantities with prepared-item records.
translations.조리·완성 확인 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to check cooking/completion/store conditions and standards
translations.메뉴·수량·옵션·제외 요청을 주문표와 대조해요. 알레르기 관련 요청은 추: Compare menu, quantity, options and exclusions to the order ticket. Handle allergy requests using confirmed ingredient information and supervisor instructions, not guesses.
translations.매장에서 확인한 레시피와 장비 지침에 따라 조리해요. 가열·냉각·재가열·: Cook according to store-confirmed recipes and equipment instructions. Use relevant validated standards and actual records for heating, cooling, reheating and holding hot.
translations.완성된 메뉴·수량·옵션·제공 상태를 확인하고 담당자에게 인계해요. 기준에: Check finished menu, quantities, options and serving condition; hand over to the responsible person. Address results that fail standards before serving.
translations.홀 서비스·고객 요청 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to connect hall service, customer requests, store conditions and standards
Check seat, menu, quantity, options and customer requests; communicate accurately to the responsible person. Check ingredient/allergy questions you cannot answer before explaining.
translations.주문과 준비된 음식을 대조해 안내해요. 추가 요청·지연·불만은 담당자에게: Compare orders with prepared food and explain. Refer additional requests, delays and complaints to the responsible person and confirm handling.
translations.다음 손님 자리 준비: Prepare seats for the next customers
translations.사용 식기를 회수하고 매장 방법에 따라 테이블과 주변을 정리해요. 분실물: Collect used dishes and tidy tables/surroundings using store methods. Hand lost property to the designated person and replenish supplies.
translations.포장·배달 인계 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to connect packaging, delivery, and store conditions and standards
translations.본품·옵션·소스·동반품을 주문표와 대조해요. 고객 요청과 제외 품목을 확: Match main items, options, sauces and accompanying items to the order ticket. Check customer requests and excluded items.
translations.메뉴에 적합한 용기와 매장 포장 방법을 사용해요. 뚜껑·누수·혼입 여부를: Use suitable containers and store packing methods. Check lids, leaks and unwanted mixing; attach required labels.
Compare order identifiers and give to the customer or driver at the designated location. Immediately refer omissions or wrong delivery to the supervisor.
translations.세척·청소 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used in connection with washing, cleaning and store conditions and standards
translations.오늘 대상 구역·기구와 승인된 세척 방법을 확인해요. 용도별 청소도구를: Check today's areas/equipment and approved washing methods. Separate cleaning tools by purpose and check product instructions.
translations.대상에 맞는 매장 방법과 장비 지침에 따라 작업해요. 주변 식재료와 작업: Use store methods and equipment instructions suitable for the target. Keep work separate to avoid affecting nearby ingredients and tasks; return tools to designated places afterward.
translations.대상 구역과 기구가 다음 작업에 사용할 수 있는 상태인지 확인해요. 손상: Check that the area and equipment are ready for next use. Record damage, drainage problems and other abnormalities; tell the responsible person.
translations.화장실 점검·청소 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used in connection with restroom inspection, cleaning, and store conditions and standards
translations.바닥·세면대·변기·통행 상태를 확인하고 필요한 비품을 보충해요. 고장이나: Check floors, sinks, toilets and access; replenish supplies. Report faults or standing water.
translations.주방용과 구분한 도구 및 매장에서 승인한 제품 지침으로 청소해요. 사용: Clean with tools separate from kitchen tools and store-approved product instructions. Check in-use notices and completion; store tools in designated places.
translations.폐기물 정리 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to connect waste management and store conditions and standards
translations.매장과 지역의 품목 구분에 따라 폐기물을 나눠요. 분류를 모르면 책임자에: Sort waste according to store and local item categories. Ask the supervisor if you do not know the classification.
translations.지정 장소로 배출: Take waste to the designated place
translations.연결된 배출 장소와 매장 배출 시점을 확인한 뒤 이동해요. 용기 주변 오: Check linked disposal locations and store disposal times before moving waste. Clean contamination/leaks around containers and clear passages.
translations.폐기물 보관 구역의 파손이나 해충 흔적은 담당자에게 알려요. 매장에서 승: Tell the responsible person about damage or pest signs in waste storage. Do not use unapproved chemicals or perform pest-control work without authorization.
translations.홀 마감 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to link hall finishing and store conditions and standards
translations.테이블·의자·바닥을 매장 청소 방법에 따라 정리해요. 손님 물품과 남은: Clean tables, chairs and floors using store methods. Check for customer belongings and remaining requests.
translations.취급 품목별 매장 보관·폐기 기준을 확인해 처리해요. 용기·도구는 지정: Check each handled item's store storage/disposal criteria and act accordingly. Wash/tidy containers and tools using specified methods; check readiness for next service.
translations.사용 중인 테이블 화구의 제조사·매장 종료 지침을 확인해요. 이상이나 종: Check manufacturer/store shutdown instructions for tabletop burners in use. Report abnormalities or uncertain shutdown status.
Sort and dispose according to store rules; use linked disposal locations.
Check dishes/supplies needed for next service and replenish from linked storage.
translations.시설 종료·인계: Shut down facilities and hand over
translations.종료할 설비와 계속 가동할 설비를 구분해 매장 지침에 따라 확인해요. 출: Distinguish equipment to shut down from equipment to keep running; check according to store instructions. Hand entrances and unfinished matters to the final responsible person.
translations.주방 마감 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used in connection with kitchen finishing and store conditions and standards
translations.제품·공정별 확인된 매장 보관·폐기 기준에 따라 잔량을 처리하고 표시해요: Handle and label leftovers according to confirmed store storage/disposal standards for each product/process. Do not decide food with unclear standards is suitable for next service.
translations.작업대·식기·설비 정리: Tidy work surfaces, dishes and equipment
translations.오늘 세척 대상과 방법을 확인해 작업하고, 다음 사용에 필요한 상태를 확: Check today's washing targets and methods, do the work and confirm readiness for next use. Follow a separate plan for regular maintenance.
translations.계속 가동해야 하는 장비와 종료할 장비를 구별해 확인해요. 표시·보관 상: Distinguish equipment to keep running from equipment to shut down. Tell the next person about labels, storage conditions, faults and sold-out items.
translations.정기 시설·장비 관리 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Regular facility and equipment management, basic procedures used in connection with store conditions and standards
translations.장비 목록과 제조사·매장 관리 계획에서 이번 대상·담당·작업 범위를 확인: Use the equipment list and manufacturer/store care plan to confirm current targets, responsibility and scope. Distinguish external contractor work from crew tasks.
translations.점검·정비 결과 인계: Hand over inspection and maintenance results
translations.허용된 작업만 수행하고 이상·조치·다음 점검 정보를 남겨요. 고장 장비의: Do only permitted work; record issues, action and next inspection information. Ask the supervisor whether faulty equipment may be used.
translations.이상·회수·영업 중단 대응: Respond to issues, recalls and service interruption
translations.이상·회수·영업 중단 대응 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본: Response to abnormalities, recalls, and business interruptions; basic procedures used in connection with store conditions and standards
translations.고장·정전·이물·제품 회수 등 상황을 발견하면 대상과 발생 위치를 확인해: For faults, power outages, foreign matter or product recalls, identify the target and location and tell the supervisor. Follow onsite emergency instructions in urgent situations.
translations.책임자 지시에 따라 영향을 받은 물품·장비·주문을 구분하고 확인된 사실과: Under supervisor instructions, identify affected goods, equipment and orders; record confirmed facts and action. Do not reuse or restart on your own.
translations.조치 완료 여부와 남은 일을 다음 담당에게 전달해요. 영업·사용 재개는: Tell the next person what actions are complete and what remains. Resume business or use only following confirmation by the designated supervisor.
translations.마감 정산·관리 인계 · 매장 조건과 기준을 연결해 사용하는 기본 절차: Basic procedures used to connect closing settlement, management handover, and store conditions and standards
translations.담당 권한 안에서 결제·취소·환불 기록과 마감 자료를 대조해요. 차이가: Within your authority, compare payment, cancellation and refund records with closing documents. Report differences with evidence to the supervisor.
translations.미완료 주문·수리 요청·다음 영업 준비 사항을 담당과 함께 남겨요. 실제: Leave unfinished orders, repair requests and next-service preparation with responsible people. Distinguish these checks from actual payments or payroll processing.
translations.매장 운영 시간·파트·할 일 연결 기준: Standard for linking store operating hours, parts, and tasks

translations.솔담 뼈찜이라는 가상 매장의 정리 본보기입니다. 실제 제품·장비·시간·파: This is an example of the organization of a virtual store called Soldam Bone Jjim. Check the actual product, equipment, time, part, location, and store standards, then select and use what you need.

Operating structure and hypothetical example.
This is not a case of actual store/recipe verification.
translations.처음 매장을 구성할 때: When first setting up a store
translations.영업·브레이크와 준비 시간을 구별: Distinguish between opening/break and preparation time
translations.장소·준비물\n입구·안내판 · 영업시간 표, 실제 근무표\n\n방법\n예:
Location/Materials
Entrance, information board, business hours table, actual work schedule

method
An example sale is 11: 00 – 21: 00, and a break is 15: 00 – 16: 00. Enter the opening preparation 09 : 30 – 11 : 00 and the closing 21 : 00 – 22 : 00 in a time zone separate from customer business hours. These hours are hypothetical and do not confirm actual hours.

Confirmation criteria
Sales, breaks, preparations, and deadlines are distinguished for each day of the week, and closed days are also visible.

If there is a problem
If it is different from actual sales, do not copy the example but replace it with the value confirmed by the person in charge.
Please check the example location name, quantity, time, and tools according to our store.
translations.파트와 직책의 역할을 나눠 정리: Divide the roles into parts and positions
translations.장소·준비물\n운영 기준 문서 · 조리·준비·설거지·홀·포장·관리 역할:
Location and supplies
Operating standards document · Role chart for cooking, prep, dishwashing, dining service, packing and management

Method
Parts describe the work, while ranks determine which changes a person may make. Being in the cooking part does not automatically grant permission to edit standards. The fictional store has 4 parts: cooking, prep and dishwashing, dining service and packing, and management.

Check
A crew member may belong to several parts; responsibilities and editing permissions remain distinct.

If there is a problem
Ask the owner or an authorized manager about changes that require management permission.
translations.루틴과 읽는 자료의 연결을 정리: Organize the connection between routines and reading materials
translations.장소·준비물\n매뉴얼 분류 · 오픈·영업·교대·마감 목록과 레시피 문서\:
Location and supplies
Manual categories · Opening, service, handover and closing lists, and recipe documents

Method
Keep the actions that need real confirmation in the routine TAP. Put detailed instructions in each action's manual. Do not turn the whole recipe into a new daily checklist. Set a separate weekly or monthly schedule for periodic care.

Check
First setup, periodic care, routines, recipes and learning have distinct purposes.

If there is a problem
If the category is unclear, identify when the document is needed before activating any work.
translations.업무 연결 전에 담당과 기준을 확인: Check responsibility and standards before connecting to work
translations.장소·준비물\n운영 준비 화면 · 파트별 필요 인원, 확인한 장소·매장:
Location/Materials
Operation preparation screen · Number of people required for each part, based on confirmed locations and stores

method
The imported examples may be readable, but they will not immediately translate into actual work. After checking the responsible part, time zone, and actual standards, the boss selects registration and connection to work. Already created records will not be overwritten with new descriptions.

Confirmation criteria
The timing and responsibility for performing each routine matches the actual work schedule.

If there is a problem
A missing setup leaves something missing and doesn't indicate that the setup is complete.
translations.반납부터 건조까지 장소와 도구 기준: Location and tool criteria from return to drying
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 처음 설정 · 설거지 구역을 처음 정리할 때: Virtual store example · First time setup · First time organizing the dishwashing area
translations.설거지 구역을 처음 정리할 때: When first organizing the dishwashing area
translations.식기의 이동 순서를 정해 이름 붙이기: Naming the order in which tableware is moved
translations.장소·준비물\n반납대 → 폐기물 분류대 → 세척대 → 건조 선반 · 실제:
Location/Materials
Return station → Waste sorting station → Washing station → Drying shelf · Photo of actual area, location name

method
Used dishes go to the return station, leftover dishes go to the sorting station, cleaning goes to the washing station, and finished dishes go to the drying shelf. Find the point where clean dishes meet returned dishes and adjust the movement line. Concatenates the example location name to the actual place ID.

Confirmation criteria
A new crew can find the same place with the same name.

If there is a problem
If a work area is missing, check the actual layout. Do not mark this complete merely by saving a temporary name.
translations.세척 도구의 용도와 보관 칸을 정하기: Determine the purpose and storage of cleaning tools
translations.장소·준비물\n비품·세척 도구장 S-01 · 제품 표시, 용도별 솔·수세:
Location/Materials
Furnishings/cleaning tool cabinet S- 01 · Product indication, brush/scrubbing pad/cloth by use

method
Distinguish between tools for dishes, floors, and cleaning the surrounding area. Cleaners and disinfectants should be used in accordance with product labeling and trained usage instructions and do not be mixed arbitrarily. The tool cabinet photo shows the correct compartment and its location after use.

Confirmation criteria
Purpose and product are differentiated, and there is a designated location for turning the tool.

If there is a problem
If there is no sign or you don't know how to use it, check with the leader and don't use it.
translations.날재료와 완성 음식 도구를 구별: Distinguish between raw ingredients and finished food utensils
translations.장소·준비물\n전처리 P-01·완성 검수 구역 · 도마·집게·용기 이름표:
Location/Materials
Pre-treatment P- 01 · Completion inspection area · Cutting board, tongs, container name tag

method
Decide on the names and spaces for the raw ingredients and finished food tools. To distinguish, we write down the colors and markings used in actual stores, and even crew members who do not know the colors can find them using letters and locations.

Confirmation criteria
Distinction criteria are confirmed by text, location, and photo.

If there is a problem
If the same tools are mixed, work is stopped and organized according to store standards.
translations.장비 안내와 이상 보고 방법 정하기: Guide to equipment and decide how to report problems
translations.장소·준비물\n가열 조리대 C-01·세척대 · 장비별 담당자, 제조사 안:
Location/Materials
Heated countertop C- 01 · Washing counter · Person in charge for each equipment, manufacturer information

method
The switch, normal display, and stop method will be explained by the person in charge who has checked the relevant equipment instructions. Leading by example does not replace training in the use of hazardous equipment. If an abnormality is found, stop, check the reader, and write down whether it can be used again.

Confirmation criteria
It is clear who explains and who checks availability.

If there is a problem
Do not operate unknown equipment or disable protective devices.

translations.장소·준비물\n냉장 R-01/R-02 · 실제 용기, 제품 표시\n\n방:
Location/Materials
Refrigerated R- 01 /R- 02 · Actual container, product indication

method
Write down the names of the compartments for unopened products, pre-processed ingredients, cooked products, and ready-made items. Check actual safety standards and ways to prevent cross-contamination. Blank spaces are marked so that they cannot be used for other purposes.

Confirmation criteria
The same material can be distinguished and found in different states.

If there is a problem
If there is no suitable space or standard, the leader decides the placement first.
translations.라벨에 남길 항목 정하기: Decide what to leave on the label
translations.장소·준비물\n보관 용기 옆 · 라벨·펜·배치 표\n\n방법\n제품 이름:
Location/Materials
Next to storage container, label, pen, placement table

method
Leave product name, condition, actual work time, batch distinction, person in charge, and store review criteria. Do not confuse the expiration date on the product label with the standards after opening and cooking. We will not create a new storage period that is not included in the example.

Confirmation criteria
The next crew can distinguish which work is for which product.

If there is a problem
If you do not know the time/status, do not fill in the example values and leave unverifiable.
translations.온도 확인 도구와 기록 기준 정하기: Establishing Temperature Checking Tools and Recording Standards
translations.장소·준비물\n냉장 구역·조리대 · 확인한 측정 도구와 매장 기준\n\n:
Location/Materials
Refrigerated areas/countertops Verified measuring tools and store standards

method
Distinguish between indicated temperatures and situations where actual product verification is required. What, where, and how to check is reviewed according to the product and process. Instructions for use, management, and abnormal range measures of the measurement tool are also written.

Confirmation criteria
Measurement locations, tools, records and abnormal actions are linked in one document.

If there is a problem
If the value cannot be verified, it is not marked as normal and is checked with the leader.
translations.재고와 준비분의 확인 방법 구별: Distinguish between methods of checking inventory and preparations
translations.장소·준비물\n재고 목록·준비분 목록 · 단위 표, 입고·완성 기록\n\:
Location/Materials
Inventory list, preparation list, unit table, receipt and completion record

method
Distinguish between ordered and received quantities, actual inventory, and actual preparations for completion. When converting inventory units and recipe units, only confirmed values ​​are used. The target quantity in the example is not registered as the actual quantity held.

Confirmation criteria
The timing and quantity of ordering, receipt, actual measurement, and completion are distinct.

If there is a problem
If records are missing or units differ, do not use calculated estimates to mark this complete.

translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 처음 설정 · 새 크루의 첫 근무 안내: Virtual store example · Initial setup · Guide to new crew’s first shift

translations.처음에 확인할 안내를 정리: Summary of instructions to check first
translations.장소·준비물\n공통 안내·주요 장소 · 매장 안내, 오늘 담당자\n\n방:
Location/Materials
Common information, main locations, store information, today's representative

method
Let's assume a situation where an already hired crew starts work for the first time. First, explain the scope of work, people to ask, key locations, and when to take breaks. Recruitment and payroll processing are not mixed into the first shift announcement.

Confirmation criteria
Your crew will know who they are responsible for and who to ask questions to.

If there is a problem
If a representative is not available or instructions are different, check with your leader.
translations.장소·준비물\n반납대·세척대 · 실제 사용하는 식기와 도구\n\n방법\n:
Location/Materials
Return station, washing station, actually used dishes and tools

method
After the initial explanation, we look at small actions together with Buddy. It shows the flow from returning dishes to sorting leftovers, and also explains why and when to stop. Do not allow yourself to use multiple devices at once.

Confirmation criteria
The description matches the actual location and tools.

If there is a problem
If the situation is difficult or dangerous, reduce the scope of practice and check together.
translations.장소·준비물\n연습하는 같은 장소 · 연습 항목과 버디 확인 항목\n\n:
Location/Materials
Same place to practice · Practice items and buddy confirmation items

method
I am leaving the facts that I have tried and the facts that Buddy has confirmed separately. Reading the document is not checked as execution. Your buddy will not complete any unseen checks on your behalf.

Confirmation criteria
There is a distinction between practiced actions and those who have confirmed them.

If there is a problem
If there is no buddy, ask the leader for the range of possible guidance without embellishing the confirmation.
translations.장소·준비물\n해당 할 일의 방법 · 장소 사진·설명·주의점\n\n방법\:
Location/Materials
How to do this, location, photos, explanations, precautions

method
Link so you can see the same explanation again within the actual to-do list. Make a note of what you don't know and what situations you need help with and supplement them during your next shift. It doesn't make you check the entire training document every time.

Confirmation criteria
You can find related methods right from one action.

If there is a problem
If the method is different from the site, a separate note will be left and the person in charge will correct it.
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 정기 관리 · 예시: 매주 월요일 브레이크: Virtual store example · Regular management · Example: Every Monday break
translations.이번 주 확인할 장비와 담당 확인: Equipment and personnel to check this week
translations.장소·준비물\n장비 목록 · 제조사 관리 항목·지난 이상 기록\n\n방법:
Location/Materials
Equipment list · Manufacturer management items · Past abnormal records

method
The virtual store will review its equipment inventory on Monday break. If the manufacturer has a separate management cycle, we follow that standard. Distinguish between daily open inspection and weekly maintenance work.

Confirmation criteria
You can see the target, cycle, authorized personnel, and unresolved items.

If there is a problem
If there is no maintenance authority or standard, determine the scope of work.
translations.장소·준비물\n세척대·조리대·측정 도구장 · 정해진 확인 표\n\n방법\:
Location/Materials
Washing station, kitchen counter, measuring tool cabinet, designated checklist

method
Observe and record signs, damage, water leaks, abnormal noises, and shortage of consumables. Part disassembly and electrical work are not performed arbitrarily. Write down the evidence for each item confirming that it is normal.

Confirmation criteria
Instead of simply reading documents, what remains is actual observation and necessary action.

If there is a problem
If it is dangerous or difficult to judge, stop using it and have a person in charge check.
translations.청소·교체·전문 점검을 구별: Distinguish between cleaning, replacement, and professional inspection
translations.장소·준비물\n해당 장비 · 제품 안내·정비 담당 기준\n\n방법\n크루:
Location/Materials
Standards for responsible equipment/product information/maintenance

method
Divide the crew into tasks that require cleaning, replacement of designated personnel, and professional inspection. Don't just complete a scheduled task. We leave you responsible for any outstanding actions and when to next check.

Confirmation criteria
Discovery, action, and reconfirmation are separated and continued on to the next shift.

If there is a problem
We do not embellish records to indicate that an actual external request or notification was sent.
translations.관리 항목과 매뉴얼 보완 확인: Check management items and manual supplementation
translations.장소·준비물\n정기 관리 문서 · 이번 점검 기록\n\n방법\n반복되는:
Location/Materials
Regular management document · Current inspection record

method
We organize repeated abnormalities and missing methods. If the equipment changes, check the instructions and photos for the equipment and then change the document. Past inspection records will not be overwritten with new descriptions.

Confirmation criteria
It's clear what we'll be looking at again at the next inspection.

If there is a problem
If the cause or effect cannot be determined, it is left unidentified.
translations.주간 재고·발주 기준 검토: Review weekly inventory and ordering standards
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 정기 관리 · 예시: 매주 화요일 브레이크: Virtual store example · Regular management · Example: Break every Tuesday
translations.부족·미확인·많이 남은 품목 구별: Distinguish between shortage, unconfirmed, and surplus items
translations.장소·준비물\n재고 목록 · 최근 입고·사용·실측 기록\n\n방법\n가상:
Location and supplies
Inventory list · Recent receipts, usage and physical counts

Method
The fictional store reviews inventory standards on Tuesdays. First check whether each number was actually confirmed. Distinguish an unknown 0 from a physically counted 0, and check the unit.

Check
The current verification status and latest evidence are clear for each item.

If there is a problem
Do not fill an unknown quantity with a recommended order quantity.
translations.최소·평소 발주량과 사용량 검토: Review minimum/usual order quantity and usage amount
translations.장소·준비물\n품목 설정 · 최근 판매·폐기·입고 변화\n\n방법\n메뉴:
Location and supplies
Item settings · Recent changes in sales, waste and receipts

Method
Identify items affected by menu or sales changes. Review minimum stock and order thresholds using actual evidence. This review checks the standards; it does not place a supplier order.

Check
The reason for each change and the person who confirmed it are recorded.

If there is a problem
Confirm an uncertain supplier, unit or price first.
translations.발주 뒤 점검 기한과 부분 입고 확인: Check inspection deadline and partial receipt after ordering
translations.장소·준비물\n발주·입고 이력 · 마지막 발주 시각과 남은 양\n\n방법:
Location and supplies
Order and receipt history · Latest order time and remaining quantity

Method
The check N days after the latest order and the weekly review are separate. An intermediate stock check or partial receipt must not delay the post-order check deadline. Verify that only the quantity actually received was added to stock.

Check
The order, quantity received, remaining quantity and check deadline are linked.

If there is a problem
If the response is unclear, check the same receipt request rather than entering another receipt.
translations.다음 운영에 필요한 기준만 바꾸기: Change only the standards necessary for the next operation
translations.장소·준비물\n재고 기준 문서 · 검토 결과\n\n방법\n확인한 품목만:
Location and supplies
Inventory standards document · Review results

Method
Change only confirmed items and keep the previous evidence. Do not copy attractive example numbers into actual stock quantities. Confirming a quantity and saving a setting are separate actions.

Check
A standards change does not create a new physical count record.

If there is a problem
Keep unconfirmed items marked as unconfirmed.
translations.월간 동선·비품 위치 검토: Monthly review of movement routes and equipment locations
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 정기 관리 · 예시: 매월 5일, 휴무면 다음 영업: Virtual store example · Regular management · Example: 5th of every month, next business day if closed
translations.예시: 매월 5일, 휴무면 다음 영업일: Example: 5th of every month, if it is a holiday, the next business day
translations.자주 막히는 동선과 구역 확인: Check frequently blocked routes and areas
translations.장소·준비물\n반납·세척·건조·포장 동선 · 현장 메모·장소 사진\n\n:
Location/Materials

Return, cleaning, drying, packaging, on-site notes, location photos


method

View points where there was inconvenience, intersection, or stacking during actual movement.
Illustrations of virtual stores are location examples and do not represent actual travel times.
Table seating is read as a set capacity.


Confirmation criteria

It is connected to which area and which behavior causes problems.


If there is a problem

It will not interfere with the movement of equipment or other crew members during use and will not be tested.
translations.장소 이름과 실제 찾는 방법 확인: See the name of the place and how to actually find it
translations.장소·준비물\n장소 목록 · 층·구역·설명·사진\n\n방법\n반납대 같은:
Location/Materials

Venue list, floor, area, description, photo


method

Make sure names, such as drop-off stands, match the site.
Photos are double-checked with their current arrangement and marked with out-of-date descriptions.
If there are multiple floors, the floor names are also written down.


Confirmation criteria

The name, floor, area, and photo refer to the same place.


If there is a problem

Places not found do not display the document as normal.
translations.변경 초안과 연결된 업무를 확인: Check tasks associated with change drafts
translations.장소·준비물\n배치 편집 초안 · 재고·과거 업무가 참조한 장소 목록\n:
Location/Materials

Batch edit draft, inventory, list of places referenced by past work


method

View existing connections before changing placement.
Clears the referenced place ID and does not create a new one with the same name.
Check the range and overlap and save it as the revision you started.


Confirmation criteria

Proposed changes and actual connectivity impacts are reviewed.


If there is a problem

If there is a conflict or an old draft, compare the latest values and check again.
translations.장소·준비물\n관련 매뉴얼 · 변경한 위치와 사진\n\n방법\n관련 할:
Location/Materials

Related manuals · Changed locations and photos


method

Make sure you find the same location in Related To Dos.
Existing historical records will not be replaced with the new location.
Explain the change to new crew members.


Confirmation criteria

The connection between place, method, and current task is correct.


If there is a problem

Unexplained changes are identified as important notices.
translations.월간 매뉴얼·확인 항목 정리: Summary of monthly manual and confirmation items
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 정기 관리 · 예시: 매월 10일, 휴무면 다음 영: Virtual store example · Regular management · Example: 10th of every month, next business day if closed
translations.예시: 매월 10일, 휴무면 다음 영업일: Example: 10th of every month, if it is a holiday, the next business day
translations.자주 찾은 방법과 어려웠던 행동 수집: Collect frequently found methods and difficult actions
translations.장소·준비물\n매뉴얼·인수인계 기록 · 실제 현장 질문과 이상 기록\n\:
Location/Materials

Manual, handover record, actual field questions and abnormal record


method

Clean up difficult-to-read descriptions, missing photos, and off-site locations.
Distinguish between what the crew actually did and whether they read the document.
We do not turn the collected questions into firm instructions.


Confirmation criteria

A distinction is made between questions, method omissions, and actual work issues.


If there is a problem

It does not produce user feedback or completion results.
translations.핵심 확인과 세부 설명 나누기: Check key points and share detailed explanations
translations.장소·준비물\n루틴 TAP·할 일 · 현재 체크리스트\n\n방법\n한 행:
Location/Materials

Routine TAP · To-do · Current Checklist


method

Just reading the detailed instructions for an action doesn't require multiple checks.
Only key actions that need to be actually performed, measured, and handed over are checked as items, and methods and tips are attached to those actions.


Confirmation criteria

You can explain the completion criteria for each item as to why they need to be checked.


If there is a problem

Important safety checks are not eliminated simply to reduce the number of checks.
translations.레시피와 운영 행동의 관계 확인: Determine the relationship between recipes and operational behavior
translations.장소·준비물\n레시피·준비 TAP · 관련 메뉴와 준비분 기준\n\n방법:
Location/Materials

Recipe·Preparation TAP·Related menu and preparation amount standards


method

Basic recipes are kept as reference documents, and preparation tasks are linked to TAPs with actual goals, responsibilities, and work points.
The same menu name does not create duplicate daily checks.


Confirmation criteria

A distinction is made between the recipe being read and the actual act of preparation.


If there is a problem

If the linked product, unit, and store standards are different, it is not automatically applied.
translations.장소·준비물\n매장 수정·공용 변경 비교 · 현재 적용본·변경 후보\n\:
Location/Materials

Comparison of store modifications and public changes · Current application version and change candidates


method

Changed documents are compared and only what the boss selects is applied.
Maintains store-specific standards and past execution/completion records.
New content does not force past work to be completed again.


Confirmation criteria

A distinction is made between current, candidate, and store revisions and when they are applied.


If there is a problem

If the content is unclear, it will be left as a suggestion and will not be said to be applied.
translations.근무 시작 · 담당·이상·위생 확인: Start of work, check responsibility, abnormality, hygiene
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 루틴 업무 · 각 근무 시작: Virtual store example · Routine tasks · Start of each shift
translations.오늘 담당과 먼저 할 일 확인: Check what to do first with your department today
translations.장소·준비물\n근무표·업무 화면 · 오늘 시간대와 파트 배정\n\n방법\:
Location/Materials

Work schedule, work screen, today’s time slot and part assignment


method

The virtual store confirms parts, time slots, and handover during the first shift.
Collaborative work understands whether one person's confirmation is reflected in the bundle.
Do not complete tasks on your own that you are not assigned to.


Confirmation criteria

You can find out your part, time, and person to ask questions today.


If there is a problem

If assignments are missing or different, check with your leader.
translations.미해결 이상과 교대 메모 읽기: Read unresolved abnormalities and shift notes
translations.장소·준비물\n인수인계·이상 기록 · 현재 미해결 목록\n\n방법\n사용:
Location/Materials

Handover/error record/current unresolved list


method

We see discontinued equipment, missing materials, and what the next shift will take over.
There is a distinction between the fact that something has been read and the fact that the problem has been solved.


Confirmation criteria

I've identified items that affect my work today.


If there is a problem

Impossible-to-perform issues will not be transferred to completion of work before action.
translations.작업 전 위생 상태와 준비물 확인: Check sanitary conditions and preparations before work
translations.장소·준비물\n손 씻는 곳·도구장 · 확인된 매장 위생 기준\n\n방법\:
Location/Materials

Hand washing area, tool cabinet, confirmed store hygiene standards


method

Prepare hand washing, work clothes, and necessary tools according to practical standards.
If it is unclear whether you can work due to your physical condition or injured area, check with the store representative.


Confirmation criteria

You are now ready and confirmed to start the actual work.


If there is a problem

Do not judge personal conditions on your own or write unnecessary sensitive information into public records.
translations.처음 하는 행동은 버디와 확인: The first thing I do is check with my buddy.
translations.장소·준비물\n오늘 첫 작업 장소 · 해당 행동의 방법\n\n방법\n처음:
Location/Materials

First place of action today · Method of action


method

Check with your buddy about tools, equipment, and new methods you are using for the first time.
For familiar routines, just check the key points and open up detailed methods when necessary.


Confirmation criteria

It's clear how much you can do and how much help you need.


If there is a problem

In situations where we feel anxious or unsure, we stop and check together.
translations.주방 오픈 · 보관·도구·준비분 확인: Open kitchen, check storage, tools and preparations
translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 루틴 업무 · 예시: 오픈 준비 시간: Virtual store example · Routine tasks · Example: opening preparation time
translations.보관 상태와 확인 필요 제품 보기: View storage status and products requiring confirmation
translations.장소·준비물\n냉장 R-01/R-02 · 제품 라벨·실제 확인 기록\n\:
Location/Materials

Refrigerated R-01/R-02 · Product label · Actual confirmation record


method

Read the storage criteria and product labeling first to determine the actual condition required.
Products without valid standards, labels, or operating times are not used as normal preparations.


Confirmation criteria

We confirmed the status and standards of the product we will be using today.


If there is a problem

Suspicious products are judged by the leader without being randomly tasted or mixed.
translations.전처리·완성 도구와 작업대 준비: Preparation of preprocessing/finishing tools and workbench
translations.장소·준비물\nP-01·C-01 · 용도별 도구와 용기\n\n방법\n날재:
Location/Materials

P-01·C-01 · Tools and containers for each purpose


method

Distinguish between raw ingredients and finished food utensils and organize the work surface.
Check where the necessary tools are prepared and check the cleaning and maintenance status according to the product instructions.


Confirmation criteria

You can find what you need without having tools from different processes mixed up.


If there is a problem

Use tools whose purpose or management status is unclear after confirmation.
translations.오늘 준비 목표와 실제 남은 양 확인: Check today's preparation goal and actual amount remaining
translations.장소·준비물\n준비분 목록 · 판매 예상·실제 준비분\n\n방법\n본보기:
Location/Materials

List of preparations, expected sales, actual preparations


method

The example goal is to prepare 10 servings of bone stew.
After checking the actual amount remaining in the store and how much you plan to use, decide how much to prepare today.
Prevents target quantities from being recorded as inventory quantities.


Confirmation criteria

A distinction is made between reserve goals and actual reserves.


If there is a problem

If the quantity cannot be confirmed, the hypothetical 10 servings will not be registered as the actual value.
translations.장소·준비물\n주방 라인 · 장비 표시·미해결 기록\n\n방법\n교육받은:
Location/Materials

Kitchen lines/equipment markings/unresolved records


method

Verifies the normal condition of equipment at the range for which you are trained.
Hand over necessary preparations and unresolved items to the leader, and check this action after actually confirming it.


Confirmation criteria

translations.가상 매장 본보기 · 교육·참고 · 이상이나 판단하기 어려운 상황: Virtual store example · Education · Reference · Abnormalities or situations that are difficult to judge
translations.이상이나 판단하기 어려운 상황: Abnormalities or situations that are difficult to judge
translations.수행 불가와 단순 주의 구별: Distinguish between impossibility and mere caution.
translations.장소·준비물\n문제가 생긴 구역 · 실제 관찰과 작업 범위\n\n방법\n:
Location/Materials

Problem area · Actual observation and scope of work


method

Distinguish between situations where you actually can't and cautions where you can proceed.
What we do not know is left unconfirmed and is not assumed to be normal.


Confirmation criteria

It's clear which todo the problem affects.


If there is a problem

If it is dangerous or difficult to judge on your own, stop and check with your leader.
translations.관찰과 필요한 사진만 남기기: Observe and leave only the necessary photos
translations.장소·준비물\n안전한 관찰 위치 · 관찰 내용·필요한 현장 사진\n\n방:
Location/Materials

Safe observation location · Observation details · Required site photos


method

We leave the status, impact, confirmation time, and necessary photos.
We do not enter dangerous areas, film, or record unnecessary personal information.


Confirmation criteria

A distinction is made between actual observation and speculation.


If there is a problem

If you can't take pictures, you'll just leave what you actually saw and won't embellish it.
translations.담당자가 실제 조치와 진행 여부 확인: Person in charge confirms actual action and progress
translations.장소·준비물\n리더 확인·해당 구역 · 원래 기록과 실제 조치\n\n방법:
Location/Materials

Leader confirmation/area/original records and actual actions


method

An authorized person will check whether actual action or progress is possible.
Creating a record does not guarantee a solution or send a notification.
Do not move unresolved impossibility issues to completion.


Confirmation criteria

You can see who did what and what needs to be revisited.


If there is a problem

Do not mark scheduled actions as resolved.
translations.재확인과 다음 근무 인계: Re-confirmation and handover to next shift
translations.장소·준비물\n다음 담당의 확인 위치 · 실제 재확인·남은 문제\n\n방:
Location/Materials

Next person in charge: Confirmation location/Actual re-confirmation/Remaining issues


method

After rechecking, distinguish between the resolved scope and the remaining scope.
Any unresolved issues from previous business days will be carried over and past work completed will not be updated.


Confirmation criteria

Discovery, action, reconfirmation, and handover are connected.


If there is a problem

A change in date or person in charge does not eliminate unresolved issues.
translations.손 씻기·복장과 몸 상태 확인: Wash your hands, check your clothes and body condition
Store your personal items, wash your hands, and put on clean work clothes and a head covering. If you have physical conditions such as vomiting or diarrhea, or have wounds on your hands, notify the person in charge before handling the food and adjust the work.

Completion criteria: Sanitary preparations and personnel verification completed before food work.
translations.이상 시: 몸 상태가 좋지 않거나 상처 보호가 어려우면 임의로 조리·배식: If something is wrong: If you feel unwell or cannot adequately protect a wound, do not start cooking or serving food on your own.
translations.오늘 날짜의 인계에서 미완료 주문, 품절 재료, 예약, 사용 중지 장비를:
Find unfulfilled orders, out-of-stock materials, reservations, and retired equipment in handovers for today's date. I ask all workers about the target, location, remaining actions, responsibility, and deadline.

Completion criteria: We confirmed who would complete what and when.
translations.이상 시: 읽을 수 없거나 담당이 없으면 해당 업무를 책임자에게 다시 연: In case of an error: If it cannot be read or is not in charge, the task is redirected to the person in charge.
translations.내 구역과 교대 시간 확인: Check your zone and shift times
translations.근무표에서 오늘 파트·교대·휴게를 확인하고 함께 일할 크루와 도움받을 버:
Check today's part, shift, and break on the work schedule and find a crew member to work with and a buddy to help. Distinguish between tasks involving heavy containers and equipment that cannot be handled alone.

Completion criteria: Can state who is in charge and how to ask for help.
translations.이상 시: 공석이나 중복 배정은 책임자에게 알리고 임의로 다른 크루의 휴: In case of abnormalities: We notify the person in charge of any vacancies or overlapping assignments and do not arbitrarily cancel other crew members’ breaks.
translations.시작 전 담당 구역 한 바퀴 확인: Check out your area before starting
Go through the workbench, passageway, and storage table in that order to see the necessary tools, materials, and obstacles. Shortages are communicated by item, quantity, and time of need.

Completion criteria: What can be started and what can be put on hold are distinguished.
In case of abnormalities: If there is water leakage, damage, or dangerous obstacles, block access and notify us first.
translations.출입문에서 좌석까지 걸으며 장애물과 물기를 치워요. 오늘 영업·브레이크·:
Walk from the door to the seat, clearing away any obstacles and moisture. Compare today's sales, break, and last order information with our store settings.

Completion criteria: Entry/evacuation corridors are open and today's guidance is correct.
translations.이상 시: 문 고장이나 미끄럼이 남으면 해당 구역을 막고 책임자에게 알려: In case of abnormality: If the door is broken or slips, block the area and notify the person in charge.
translations.테이블 번호별 좌석·집기 세팅: Seating and furniture settings by table number
translations.테이블을 번호 순서로 닦고 의자·받침·메뉴판을 놓아요. 인원별 앞접시·수:
Wipe the tables in numerical order and place chairs, coasters, and menus. Fill each person with plates, cutlery, toilet paper, and wet tissues and check for shaking or damage.

Completion criteria: Clean fixtures suitable for the number of people booked and do not encroach on the aisles.
In case of abnormalities: Remove broken dishes and wobbly chairs and place replacements.
translations.셀프바 용기·도구·표시 준비: Preparation of self-bar containers, tools, and signs
translations.사용하는 매장만 진행해요. 깨끗한 용기에 첫 제공분만 담고 품명·준비 시:
Only go to the stores you use. Put only the first serving in a clean container and mark the product name and preparation time. Place special tongs for each food and check storage conditions.

Completion criteria: Food, special tools, and markings match, and supplements are stored in designated locations.
translations.이상 시: 시간·보관 이력이 불명확하거나 오염된 음식은 새 음식과 섞지: In case of abnormalities: Do not mix food with unclear time/storage history or is contaminated with new food and hold off on using it.
translations.음용수·컵과 소모품 채우기: Filling drinking water, cups and consumables
translations.컵의 이물·파손을 보고 깨끗한 보관대에 놓아요. 정수기 출수부와 물받이를:
Check the cup for any foreign matter or damage and place it on a clean storage stand. Check the water purifier outlet and water tray and fill toilet paper and packaging bags to the designated standard.

Completion criteria: We have secured enough water and a clean discharge area to receive our first guests.
translations.이상 시: 물이 이상하거나 장비 누수가 있으면 사용을 멈추고 대체 음용수: In case of abnormality: If the water is abnormal or the equipment is leaking, stop using it and decide with the person in charge about alternative drinking water.
translations.예약 인원과 좌석, 품절 메뉴, 대기 안내를 홀·주방 담당과 맞춰요. 현:
Coordinate reservation numbers, seats, sold out menus, and waiting information with the hall and kitchen staff. Explain to each other one change that is easy to ask questions about in the field.

Completion criteria: The hall and kitchen know the same sales menu and instructions.
translations.이상 시: 확인되지 않은 메뉴·가격·혜택은 손님에게 약속하지 말고 담당자: In case of abnormalities: Do not promise unconfirmed menus, prices, or benefits to customers, but confirm with the person in charge.
translations.작업대·도구 청결 확인: Check cleanliness of workbench and tools
translations.전날 마감 기록을 읽고 작업대·도마·칼·집게를 살펴요. 생재료와 바로 먹:
Read the previous day's deadline record and check the workbench, cutting board, knife, and tongs. Divide the work area and tools for raw ingredients and ready-to-eat food and place washed and dried tools.

Completion criteria: No contaminated tools and no intersecting work streams.
In case of abnormality: If there is contamination or cracks, remove the tool and reclean or replace it.
translations.당일 재료·준비량 대조: Comparison of ingredients and preparation amount on the day
translations.예약·예상 주문과 사용 가능한 잔량을 비교해 첫 준비분과 추가 준비분을:
Compare the reservation/expected order and the available remaining amount and write down the initial preparation amount and additional preparation amount. The product name, time, and usage standards on the label match the actual ingredients.

Completion criteria: You can find out how much to prepare for each menu and what items are lacking.
In case of abnormality: Do not use materials without a label or history first, but separate and check.
translations.보관 장비 표시·문 닫힘 확인: Indication of storage equipment and confirmation of door closure
translations.냉장·냉동고별 표시값을 해당 매장 기준과 대조해 기록해요. 문 패킹, 닫:
The displayed values for each refrigerator and freezer are compared with the store standards and recorded. Check door packing, closure, vent blocking, and leaks.

Completion criteria: The actual displayed value and inspection time for each equipment remain and the door closes.
translations.이상 시: 기준 이탈 시 재료의 시간·온도 이력을 확인하도록 책임자에게: In case of abnormality: In case of deviation from the standard, notify the person in charge to check the time and temperature history of the material, and normal processing will not be carried out arbitrarily.
translations.가열 장비 준비와 안전 동선 확인: Prepare heating equipment and check safe movement routes
translations.교육받은 장비만 제조사 절차로 가동해요. 손잡이·보호구·뜨거운 용기 받침:
Operate only trained equipment according to manufacturer procedures. Prepare handles, protective gear, and hot container trays, and clear the transport passage.

Completion criteria: Available equipment and disabled equipment are distinguished.
translations.이상 시: 가스 냄새·연기·이상 소음은 작업을 중단하고 매장 비상 절차를: In case of abnormalities: If there is a gas odor, smoke, or abnormal noise, stop work and follow the store emergency procedures.
translations.조리·배식·설거지 동선 맞추기: Coordinating cooking, serving, and dishwashing movements
translations.깨끗한 음식이 나가는 쪽과 사용 식기가 돌아오는 쪽을 분리해요. 주문표:
Separate the side where clean food goes out and the side where used utensils come back. Check the order table location, completion call, and support request method.

Completion criteria: Ordered, finished products, and returned dishes can be found in each location without being mixed up.
translations.이상 시: 공간이 부족하면 담당자와 작업 시간을 나누고 임의로 식품 옆에: In case of abnormalities: If there is insufficient space, divide the work time with the person in charge and do not arbitrarily pile contaminated dishes next to the food.
translations.실재고·사용 가능량 확인: Check actual inventory and available quantity
translations.품목별 단위와 보관 위치를 맞추고 실재고를 세요. 폐기 예정·격리분은 판:
Match the unit and storage location for each item and calculate actual inventory. Items scheduled for disposal or quarantine are excluded from the sellable quantity, and items already ordered and unstocked are recorded separately.

Completion criteria: Inventory, availability, and non-stock are distinguished to avoid duplicate orders.
translations.이상 시: 수량이나 단위가 맞지 않으면 재계수하고 확인 전 주문 수량을: In case of abnormality: If the quantity or unit does not match, it is recalculated and the order quantity is not confirmed before confirmation.
translations.다음 납품 전 필요한 양 계산: Calculate how much you need before your next delivery
translations.다음 납품일까지의 예약·판매 예상량과 매장 안전재고를 합한 뒤 사용 가능:
Add the expected amount of reservations and sales until the next delivery date and the store's safety stock, then subtract the available stock and unstocked stock. Organize the required amount according to the packaging unit.

Completion criteria: You can explain the basis for the quantity required and the desired delivery date.
translations.이상 시: 수요나 납품일이 불확실하면 가정과 부족 예상 시점을 책임자에게: In case of abnormalities: If demand or delivery date is uncertain, inform the person in charge of the assumptions and expected timing of shortage.
translations.품명·규격·대체품 조건 대조: Comparison of product names, specifications, and replacement product conditions
translations.같은 이름의 다른 규격을 구분하고 중량·포장수·단가·최소 주문량을 대조해:
Distinguish between different specifications with the same name and compare weight, number of packages, unit price, and minimum order quantity. For substitute products with changed raw materials, check the menu and allergy information.

Completion criteria: You can check the item, specification, unit, delivery date, and quantity at once on the order form.
In case of abnormalities: Substitute products will not be changed without approval.
translations.승인 요청과 주문 확인 인계: Handover of approval request and order confirmation
translations.담당자에게 발주 초안을 보여주고 승인된 경로로 주문했는지 확인해요. 주문:
Show the order draft to the person in charge and confirm that the order has been placed through the approved channel. Record the order confirmation number, expected delivery date, and unconfirmed items and convey them to the warehouse manager.

Completion criteria: Approval, actual order, and scheduled receipt are distinguished.
translations.이상 시: 초안 작성이나 앱 체크를 실제 공급처 주문 완료로 기록하지 않: In case of abnormalities: drafting or app checking is not recorded as actual supplier order completion.
translations.주문서와 납품 실물 대조: Comparison of order form and actual delivery
translations.납품 차량에서 받은 품목을 주문서와 하나씩 맞춰요. 품명·규격·수량·단위:
Match the items received from the delivery vehicle with the order form one by one. Look at the product name, specifications, quantity, unit, lot, and deadline and write down the delivery time and supplier.

Completion criteria: Actual quantities and inconsistent items are recorded separately.
translations.이상 시: 미주문·대체·누락품은 정상 입고와 구분하고 책임자에게 확인해요: In case of abnormalities: Distinguish unordered, substituted, or missing items from normal stock and check with the person in charge.
translations.포장·상태와 보관 조건 확인: Check packaging, condition and storage conditions
translations.포장 파손·누출·오염·해동 흔적을 보고 표시된 보관 조건을 확인해요. 매:
Look for signs of packaging damage, leakage, contamination, or thawing and check the indicated storage conditions. We actually measure and record the required temperature according to the store inspection standards.

Completion criteria: Track inspection targets and actual results.
translations.이상 시: 외관·냄새만으로 안전을 확정하지 말고 기준 미달품을 판매 재고: In case of abnormalities: Do not confirm safety based on appearance or smell alone; separate products that do not meet standards from sales inventory.
translations.문제 품목에 사용 보류 표시를 붙이고 품명·수량·로트·사유·사진을 남겨요:
Attach a use pending sign to the problem item and leave the product name, quantity, lot, reason, and photo. Communicate the facts to the delivery department and person in charge to decide on a return or follow-up action.

Completion criteria: Hold items cannot be accidentally used by other crew members.
translations.이상 시: 공급처와 처리 합의가 안 되면 임의 사용·폐기하지 말고 책임자: In case of abnormalities: If there is no agreement on disposal with the supplier, do not use or dispose of it arbitrarily, but leave it to the person in charge.
translations.냉장·냉동 등 제품 표시와 매장 기준에 맞는 장소로 옮겨요. 기존 재고와:
Move to a location that meets product labeling and store standards, such as refrigeration and freezing. Match existing inventory and order of use, but separate raw ingredients from ready-to-eat food.

Completion criteria: Labels and storage locations are linked with no ingredients left in the aisles.
translations.이상 시: 공간이 부족하면 부적절한 장소에 두지 말고 대체 보관을 승인받: In case of abnormality: If there is insufficient space, do not leave it in an inappropriate place and obtain approval for alternative storage.
translations.실제 받은 수량으로 입고 기록: Record receipt with actual received quantity
Only confirmed normal receipts are reflected in inventory, and returns, holds, and non-receipts are kept separately. Compare the delivery note and records again and forward them to the next person in charge.

Completion criteria: Recorded quantity matches actual stored quantity.
In case of an abnormality: The entire order quantity is not processed as received.
translations.보관 위치·라벨·사용 순서 정리: Organizing storage location, label, and order of use
translations.보관대별로 품명·개봉 또는 준비 시각·매장 사용기한을 읽어요. 먼저 사용:
Read the product name, opening or preparation time, and store expiration date for each storage unit. First, we separate the raw materials and finished foods with the approved inventory to be used.

Completion criteria: Other crew members can immediately find the ingredients and the order of use.
translations.이상 시: 라벨을 추정해 새로 붙이지 말고 불명확한 재료는 사용을 보류해: In case of an abnormality: Do not guess and re-apply the label, and withhold use of unclear ingredients.
translations.개·봉·중량 등 정한 단위로 세고 개봉분을 구분해 적어요. 두 사람이 세:
Count by determined units such as opening, bag, weight, etc., and write down the number of openings separately. For areas counted by two people, the overlapping range is divided first.

Completion criteria: Item, location, unit, actual quantity, inspection time remaining.
translations.이상 시: 장부 차이는 재계수하고 판매·입고·폐기 기록을 확인해 원인을: In case of abnormalities: Differences in ledgers are recalculated and sales, receipt, and disposal records are checked to determine the cause.
translations.기한·손상·격리품 점검: Check expiration, damage, and quarantined items
translations.기한 임박, 포장 손상, 누출, 해동 흔적을 살펴요. 사용 가능한 임박품:
Look for signs of approaching expiration, packaging damage, leaks, or thawing. Distinguish between ready-to-use items and items awaiting disposal or judgment and deliver them to the person in charge.

Completion criteria: Prohibited materials are separated from sales inventory.
If something is wrong: If the use-by date or handling history is unknown, do not judge safety by tasting.
translations.보관 설비와 통풍 공간 확인: Check storage facilities and ventilation space
Look at door closures, display values, and shelf contamination, and tidy up floor stacking and ventilation openings. Do not place detergents or personal items on food.

Completion criteria: Can be removed while maintaining storage conditions and cleanliness.
translations.이상 시: 장비 이상은 영향을 받은 식품과 함께 보고해 이동 여부를 승인: In case of abnormalities: Equipment abnormalities are reported along with the affected food to receive approval for movement.
translations.재고 차이와 보충 필요 인계: Handover inventory differences and replenishment needs
translations.부족·과잉·임박·격리 품목을 수량·위치와 함께 남겨요. 주문 후 재고 확:
Leave shortage, surplus, imminent, and quarantined items along with their quantity and location. If you are checking inventory after ordering, mark the order and record only the results.

Completion criteria: The person in charge has data to decide the next purchase, use, and disposal.
translations.이상 시: 중간 점검이나 입고로 주문 기준 확인 기한을 임의로 미루지 않: In case of abnormalities: The order standard confirmation deadline is not arbitrarily postponed due to interim inspection or warehousing.
translations.레시피·수량·사용 시점 확인: Check recipe, quantity, and timing of use
translations.메뉴별 승인 레시피에서 재료·배수·절단 크기를 확인해요. 첫 준비량과 추:
Check the ingredients, drainage, and cutting size in the approved recipes for each menu. Write down the initial preparation amount, additional preparation amount, and when to use it on the worksheet.

Completion criteria: There are a set of ingredients to prepare and how much to prepare.
translations.이상 시: 배합·기준이 없거나 주문량이 바뀌면 임의로 늘리지 말고 담당자: In case of abnormalities: If there are no formulations/standards or the order quantity changes, do not arbitrarily increase it but adjust it with the person in charge.
translations.생육·해산물과 바로 먹는 채소·완성식품의 도구·용기를 구분해요. 먼저 할:
Separate tools and containers for raw meat and seafood from those for ready-to-eat vegetables and finished foods. Decide what to do first and clean up your hands and work surface before starting.

Completion criteria: The prepared tools are separated by material and are clean.
translations.이상 시: 같은 도구를 써야 하면 작업 사이 세척·소독 절차를 마친 뒤: In case of anomalies: If the same tool must be used, switch after completing the cleaning and disinfection procedures between tasks.
translations.제품 표시와 승인 레시피 순서대로 세척·손질하고 저울의 용기 무게를 뺀:

translations.준비 수량과 부족분 인계: Handover of prepared quantity and shortfall
translations.완료 수량·보관 위치·남은 원재료와 부족분을 담당자에게 전달해요. 도구를:
Communicate the completed quantity, storage location, remaining raw materials, and shortages to the person in charge. Clean tools and remove contamination from work surfaces and floors.

Completion criteria: The next worker can find the supplies and the area is cleared.
translations.이상 시: 미완료는 완료로 체크하지 말고 남은 수량과 예상 마무리 시각을: In case of abnormalities: Do not check incomplete as completed, but leave the remaining quantity and expected completion time.
translations.주문번호·메뉴·옵션 읽기: Read order number, menu, and options
translations.주문번호와 테이블 또는 포장 채널, 수량·사이즈·맵기·제외·추가 요청을:
Recite the order number, table or packaging channel, quantity, size, spiciness, exclusion, and addition requests out loud. The change table is separate from the previous order.

Open the mixing, quantity, equipment, and completion criteria of the approved recipe and check the label of the batch. Separate plates and tongs for finished products from raw material tools.
