translations.메뉴별 조리 순서 수행: Perform cooking sequence for each menu
translations.레시피에 정한 투입 순서·분량·화력·시간을 따라요. 배치별 시작 시각을:
Follow the input order, amount, heat power, and time set in the recipe. Distinguish the start time for each batch and leave the time and temperature that need to be confirmed as the actual values.

Completion criteria: The menu has met the verified cooking completion criteria.
translations.이상 시: 익힘 미달이나 기록 누락은 정상 출고하지 말고 책임자가 정한: In case of abnormalities: If the food is not cooked well or has missing records, do not ship it normally and follow the reprocessing/disposal procedures set by the person in charge.
translations.완성품과 주문표 대조: Comparison of finished products and order sheets
translations.메뉴·수량·옵션·소스·사이드·접시 가장자리와 이물을 확인해요. 한 주문의:
Check the menu, quantity, options, sauce, side, edge of the plate, and foreign substances. Gather items from one order and coordinate the order of delivery with the hall or packaging manager.

Completion criteria: The order sheet matches the actual item, with no omissions or mix-ups with other orders.
translations.이상 시: 틀린 옵션·품목은 표시를 바꾸는 것만으로 처리하지 말고 재조리: In case of abnormalities: Do not deal with incorrect options/items by simply changing the label, but check whether or not they should be recooked.
translations.용기 손잡이와 받침을 확인하고 이동 경로를 비워요. 주문번호·뜨거움·남은:
Check the container handle and base and clear the movement path. Tell the delivery person your order number, hotness, and remaining items and confirm delivery.

Completion criteria: The recipient and delivery order are confirmed.
In case of abnormalities: If there is overflow or damage to the container, stop moving and repackage safely.
translations.인원·테이블과 주문 메뉴·수량·옵션을 확인하고 주문 내용을 다시 읽어 드:
We will check the number of people, table, order menu, quantity, and options, and read your order again. Out of stock and waiting times will be informed based on information confirmed by the kitchen.

Completion criteria: Customer and order details match and order number remains.
translations.이상 시: 알레르기·제외 요청은 임의로 가능하다고 답하지 말고 조리 담당: In case of abnormalities: Do not reply that allergy/exclusion requests can be made arbitrarily, but check with the person in charge of cooking.

Completion criteria: The kitchen knows the latest request and distinguishes it from previous requests.
translations.이상 시: 전달이 누락되면 손님에게 현재 상태를 설명하고 책임자에게 연결: In case of abnormality: If delivery is missed, explain the current status to the customer and connect to the person in charge.
translations.테이블·메뉴 대조 후 제공: Provided after comparing table and menu
translations.테이블 번호와 메뉴를 확인하고 뜨거운 그릇은 미리 알린 뒤 안정된 위치에:
Check the table number and menu, announce hot dishes in advance, and place them in a stable location. Do not pass hot food over children, bags, or belongings.

Completion criteria: Safely served to the right guests and the remaining menu items confirmed.
In case of abnormalities: If the orders are different, we will check with the customer and do not arbitrarily exchange or merge.
translations.불편·지연·추가 요청 처리: Handling inconveniences, delays, and additional requests
translations.손님 말을 끊지 않고 사실을 확인해 주문번호·문제·요청을 책임자에게 전해:
Confirm the facts without interrupting the customer and convey the order number, problem, and request to the person in charge. Clearly state possible actions and when to provide guidance after confirmation.

Completion criteria: It is determined who will provide follow-up information.
In case of an abnormality: We do not promise refunds, compensation, or safety judgment outside of our authority.
translations.분실물을 먼저 확인하고 식기·잔반을 수거해요. 테이블과 의자 접촉면을 정:
First check for lost items and collect dishes and leftovers. After cleaning up the contact surfaces of the table and chairs, place new clean furniture and look at the floor.

Completion criteria: You can receive the next guest without contaminated dishes or leftover dishes.
translations.이상 시: 분실물은 임의 사용·공개하지 말고 발견 위치·시각과 함께 책임: In case of abnormalities: Do not use or disclose lost items arbitrarily, but hand them over to the person in charge along with the location and time of discovery.
translations.주문표 한 장씩 구성 확인: Confirm the configuration of the order sheet one by one
translations.한 주문의 본품·사이드·소스·음료·수저·제외 요청을 순서대로 읽어요. 여:
Read the main product, side, sauce, drink, cutlery, and exclusion request from one order in order. Place multiple orders in a separate box and indicate the order number.

Completion criteria: Distinguish between ready and waiting items for an order.
In case of abnormalities: If different orders are mixed, all are compared again.
translations.메뉴에 맞는 용기 준비: Prepare containers suitable for the menu
translations.식품용 용기를 확인하고 파손·오염·뚜껑 규격을 봐요. 뜨거운 것과 차가운:
Check food containers and check for damage, contamination, and lid specifications. Differentiate between hot and cold, soup and dry food according to store packaging standards.

Completion criteria: Have a clean container to hold the item and a matching lid.
In case of abnormality: If there are no specifications, do not substitute a random container and check with the person in charge.
translations.밀폐·누수·외부 오염 확인: Check sealing, leakage, and external contamination
translations.용기를 과하게 채우지 않고 뚜껑을 가장자리까지 닫아요. 안정된 상태에서:
Do not overfill the container and close the lid to the brim. In a stable state, check for sealing and leakage and clean the outside of the container.

Completion criteria: The lid does not lift or leak and does not tilt during transportation.
translations.이상 시: 뜨거운 국물을 무리하게 기울이거나 눌러 확인하지 말고 용기를: In case of abnormality: Replace the container without excessively tilting or pressing the hot soup.
translations.실물과 주문표를 한 번 더 맞추고 무거운 용기는 아래에 놓아요. 봉투에:
Match the actual item with the order sheet once more and place the heavy container below. The order number and the total number of envelopes if there are multiple envelopes are indicated on the envelope.

Completion criteria: Packages per order are identified with no omissions.
In case of an error: Do not check any unconfirmed items, but check with the person in charge of cooking.
translations.수령자 주문번호와 인계 대조: Comparison of handover with recipient order number
translations.손님 또는 기사에게 주문번호를 확인하고 봉투 수·음료·취급 주의를 전해요:
Confirm the order number with the customer or driver and inform them of the number of bags, drinks, and handling precautions. After actual receipt, the handover time and status are recorded.

Completion criteria: All envelopes have been delivered to the correct recipients.
translations.이상 시: 수령 지연품은 매장 보관·출고 기준으로 관리하고 기준을 넘으면: In case of abnormalities: Delayed receipt of products is managed based on store storage and shipment standards, and if the standards are exceeded, the person in charge is notified.
translations.식품과 깨끗한 식기를 치우고 청소할 구역을 표시해요. 제품 라벨에서 적용:
Remove food and clean dishes and mark the area to be cleaned. Check the application surface, dilution, contact time, rinsing, and protective equipment on the product label and prepare tools specifically for the area.

Completion criteria: Food is not exposed and the correct products and tools are in place.
translations.이상 시: 라벨 없는 약품이나 용도가 다른 제품을 쓰거나 서로 섞지 않아: In case of abnormalities: Do not use or mix drugs without labels or products for different purposes.
translations.찌꺼기·기름 등 큰 오염 제거: Removal of major contaminants such as debris and oil
translations.음식물과 이물을 먼저 수거하고 배수망·틈새의 찌꺼기를 제거해요. 칼날·깨:
First, collect food and foreign substances and remove debris from the drain net and crevices. Do not sweep up blades or broken pieces by hand.

Completion criteria: Major contamination and hazardous materials have been removed prior to cleaning.
In case of abnormality: Remove sharp objects with a tool and indicate the location of the damage.
translations.해당 표면과 제품 지침대로 세척하고 필요한 헹굼·소독을 진행해요. 소독이:
Clean according to the surface and product instructions and perform any necessary rinsing and disinfection. For surfaces requiring disinfection, check the specified concentration and contact time.

Completion criteria: Decontamination and necessary treatment of product have been completed.
translations.이상 시: 시간·희석을 모르거나 잘못 적용했으면 완료하지 말고 지침을 다: In case of abnormalities: If you do not know the time/dilution or applied incorrectly, do not complete and recheck the instructions.
translations.세척한 식기는 물이 빠지는 깨끗한 건조대에 두고 마른 뒤 보관해요. 청소:
Place washed dishes on a clean drying rack where water drains and dry before storing. Wash and dry cleaning tools and separate them with food and clean utensils.

Completion criteria: No contact with contaminated water or wet contaminated cloths again.
translations.이상 시: 덜 마른 식기를 포개거나 더러운 행주로 닦아 마무리하지 않아요: In case of abnormalities: Do not stack less dry dishes or wipe them with a dirty dishcloth.
translations.빛 아래서 결과 확인·재개: Check results and resume under light
translations.손잡이·모서리·배수구와 바닥을 다시 보고 찌꺼기·잔여 제품·물기를 확인해:
Check the handles, edges, drains, and floor again to check for debris, remaining product, and moisture. Recover items and leave a cleanup time and unfinished portion.

Completion Criteria: Ensure clear surfaces and safe passageways before opening the area.
In case of abnormality: If contamination remains, reprocess the affected area and re-inspect.
translations.사용 중 표시와 비품 확인: Check signs and supplies during use
translations.손님 사용 여부를 보고 청소 중 안내를 세워요. 휴지·비누·건조 수단,:
We check whether guests are using it and provide guidance during cleaning. Check toilet paper, soap, drying equipment, toilets and sinks for blockages, leaks, and lighting.

Completion criteria: Guides user access and provides information on supplementary and defective items.
In case of abnormality: If there is sewage overflow or damage, stop using and notify the person in charge.
translations.깨끗한 곳에서 오염된 곳 순서로 청소: Clean from clean to contaminated areas
translations.화장실 전용 장갑·도구로 손잡이·세면대·변기·바닥을 구분해 처리해요. 제:
Use bathroom-specific gloves and tools to separate handles, sinks, toilets, and floors. Follow product instructions and do not use toilet utensils in the sink or kitchen.

Completion criteria: No visible contamination or residual product on contact surfaces, toilet, or floor.
translations.이상 시: 체액·날카로운 물체는 일반 청소로 덮지 말고 정해진 별도 절차: In case of an abnormality: Do not cover body fluids or sharp objects with general cleaning, but check the designated separate procedures.
translations.비품 채우고 작동 확인: Fill in supplies and check operation
translations.휴지·비누를 채우고 물 내림·수도·건조 수단을 확인해요. 물기를 없애고:
Fill with toilet paper and soap, and check the flushing, tap, and drying means. Remove moisture, seal the trash, and move it to the designated route.

Completion criteria: Ready for guest use and non-slippery floor.
In case of abnormalities: In case of repeated blockages or water leaks, temporary measures and restrictions on use are taken over.
translations.도구 분리 보관·손 씻기: Store tools separately and wash hands
translations.화장실 도구를 씻고 말려 지정 위치에 놓아요. 장갑을 벗고 손을 씻은 뒤:
Wash and dry the bathroom tools and place them in the designated location. Take off your gloves, wash your hands, and return to other tasks. Leave inspection time and unresolved issues.

Completion criteria: Restroom re-opened without transferring contamination to the hall or kitchen.
In case of abnormalities: If cleaning tools are mixed, stop using them and separate and reprocess them.
translations.매장 배출 안내에 따라 내용물과 포장재를 나눠요. 깨진 유리·날카로운 물:
Distribute contents and packaging materials according to store disposal instructions. For broken glass and sharp objects, use designated containers and markings.

Completion criteria: Contained in each type of container without contamination of foreign substances.
translations.이상 시: 분류가 불명확하면 책임자에게 확인하고 음식물통에 약품·위험물을: In case of abnormalities: If the classification is unclear, check with the person in charge and do not throw away medicines or dangerous substances in the food container.
translations.넘치기 전 밀폐·무게 확인: Check seal and weight before overflowing
translations.지정 채움선 전에 비우고 봉투를 묶어요. 새는 곳과 운반 무게를 보고 필:
Empty and tie the envelope before the designated fill line. If necessary, two people move it after checking for leaks and the weight of the transport.

Completion criteria: Can be lifted safely without leaking.
translations.이상 시: 압축하려고 손을 넣지 말고 누출 봉투는 적합한 외부 용기로 보: In case of abnormality: Do not put your hand in to compress it, but reinforce the leak bag with a suitable external container.
translations.지정 시각·장소로 배출: Discharge at designated time and location

Completion criteria: Comply with discharge rules and do not block entry/escape passageways.
translations.이상 시: 배출 장소가 잠겨 있으면 임의 장소에 두지 말고 임시 보관을: In case of abnormality: If the discharge location is locked, do not leave it in a random place and check for temporary storage.
translations.용기 세척과 해충 흔적 보고: Cleaning containers and reporting signs of pests
translations.쓰레기통과 주변 누출을 전용 도구로 정리하고 손을 씻어요. 벌레·배설물·:
Clean up trash and surrounding spills with a special tool and wash your hands. The location and time of insects, excrement, and gnawed traces are recorded and notified to the person in charge.

Completion criteria: Empty container and surrounding area are clean and lid is closed.
translations.이상 시: 식품 주변에 임의로 살충제를 뿌리지 말고 영향을 받은 식품을: In case of abnormalities: Do not arbitrarily spray pesticides around food and identify affected foods.
translations.테이블·의자·바닥 순서로 정리: Organized in order of table, chair, floor
translations.마지막 손님 퇴석과 분실물을 확인한 뒤 식기·잔반을 수거해요. 테이블 번:
After checking the last guest’s departure and any lost items, we collect the dishes and leftover dishes. Arrange the contact surfaces, chairs, and floor in order of table number and inspect for damage.

Completion criteria: Each table is empty, clean and aisles are free of furniture.
translations.이상 시: 손님이 남은 구역은 청소 범위를 나누고 분실물·파손을 인계해요: In case of an abnormality: Divide the cleaning scope into areas where guests remain and hand over lost and damaged items.
translations.셀프바 음식·용기·도구 마감: Finishing of self-bar food, containers, and tools
translations.사용하는 매장만 진행해요. 제공했던 음식과 미제공 보관분을 나누고 보관:
Only go to the stores you use. We divide the provided food from the unprovided food and process it according to storage history and store standards. Wash and dry the side dish container, tongs, and screen.

Completion criteria: Food processing and utensil cleaning have been completed and there is no residue.
translations.이상 시: 음식 이력이 불명확하면 새 재료와 섞거나 다음 날 사용으로 임: In case of abnormalities: If the food history is unclear, do not mix it with new ingredients or arbitrarily designate it for use the next day.
translations.테이블 화구 종료 확인: Check the end of the table burner
translations.화구가 있는 매장만 진행해요. 식은 상태와 제조사 절차를 확인하고 지정된:

Completion criteria: I personally checked the end status of each table.
translations.이상 시: 가스 냄새·파손·잔열 위험이 있으면 조작을 중단하고 책임자에게: In case of abnormality: If there is a risk of gas odor, damage, or residual heat, stop operation and immediately notify the person in charge.
translations.구역별 쓰레기를 나누어 담고 지정 장소·시간에 배출해요. 용기와 주변 바:
Separate waste by area and dispose of it at a designated place and time. Clean up the container and the surrounding floor and wash your hands.

Completion criteria: There are no leftovers, leaks, or overflowing trash cans in the hall.
In case of abnormality: If discharge is not possible, record the location and person in charge of next disposal.
Fill toilet paper, wet tissues, cups, and packaging materials up to the store standard and adjust the location of spare parts. For items that are lacking, write down the remaining amount and the amount needed for the next business.

Completion criteria: Supplies can be found immediately by the following personnel:
In case of abnormality: If there is no stock, do not check that it has been filled but leave a replenishment request.
translations.소등·문단속과 인계 완료: Lights out, door locked and handover completed
translations.상시 가동 장비 목록을 먼저 확인해요. 종료 대상 조명·간판·냉난방만 끄:
First check which equipment must remain on. Switch off only the lights, signs, heating and cooling marked for shutdown, then check windows and doors. Leave notes about faults, reservations and unfinished work for the next person responsible.

Completion: Equipment that must stay on remains running; locks, closing time and the person who checked are recorded.
translations.이상 시: 사람이 남았는지 확인하기 전 잠그지 말고, 이상은 책임자에게: In case of an abnormality: Do not lock it before checking if anyone is left, and hand over the abnormality to the person in charge.
translations.남은 식재료 사용 이력 확인: Check the use history of remaining food ingredients
translations.품목별 조리·개봉·보관 이력과 남은 양을 확인해요. 승인 기준에 따라 보:
Check the cooking, opening, storage history and remaining amount of each item. Storage, disposal, and waiting for judgment are divided according to approval standards and are not mixed.

Completion criteria: Each remaining amount is handled and the person responsible is clear.
translations.이상 시: 이력을 모르는 식품은 재가열만으로 다음 영업 사용을 승인하지: In case of abnormalities: Food whose history is unknown will not be approved for use in the next business just by reheating.
translations.보관할 조리식품 냉각·표시: Cooling and labeling of cooked food for storage
The actual time and temperature are recorded according to the container dividing and cooling procedures verified in the store. Attach the product name, batch, expiration date, and storage location.

Completion criteria: Only quantities that meet verified cooling standards and storage conditions are stored.
translations.이상 시: 큰 솥을 실온 방치하지 말고 기준 이탈분은 사용을 보류해 책임: In case of abnormalities: Do not leave the large pot at room temperature, withhold use of any portion that deviates from the standard, and notify the person in charge.
translations.작업대·식기·설비 청소: Cleaning work surfaces, dishes, and equipment
Remove food, allow equipment to cool and stop safely, then clean to the permitted extent. Wash and dry knives, cutting boards, and containers, and empty the waste from the drain net.

Completion criteria: Tools are stored dry without food, oil, or product residue.
In case of abnormalities: Do not spray water on the electrical part or disassemble parts without training.
translations.종료 장비와 상시 가동 장비 구분: Distinguish between shutdown equipment and always-on equipment
translations.매장 종료 목록에 따라 화구·작업 장비의 전원·밸브 상태를 하나씩 확인해:
Check the power and valve status of the cooking utensils and work equipment one by one according to the store shutdown list. We maintain facilities that are always in operation, such as refrigeration and freezing.

Completion criteria: Devices to turn off and devices to keep on match the list.
In case of abnormalities: If you don't know how to end it, don't block it arbitrarily, but check with the person in charge.
translations.냉장·냉동고와 바닥 최종 확인: Final check of refrigerator, freezer and floor
translations.장비별 표시값·문 닫힘·라벨과 누수를 보고 통로의 물기·장애물을 제거해요:
Check the display values, door closures, labels, and water leaks for each equipment and remove moisture and obstacles in the passage. Leave shortages, scraps, failures, and incompletes along with quantity and location.

Completion criteria: Check storage conditions and safe passage, and the next person in charge can read the handover.
translations.이상 시: 온도 이상·문 고장은 식품 영향과 임시 조치를 함께 책임자에게: In case of abnormalities: Temperature abnormalities or door failures are reported to the person in charge along with the impact on the food and temporary measures.
translations.이번 점검 대상·주기 확인: Check the target and frequency of this inspection
translations.장비대장에서 모델·위치·최근 점검일·다음 예정일을 보고 이번 대상을 골라:
Select the current target by looking at the model, location, most recent inspection date, and next scheduled date in the equipment ledger. The manufacturer's guidelines distinguish between cleaning and visual inspection that can be performed by crews and professional maintenance.

Completion criteria: Responsibility, scheduled date, and allowable scope of work are determined.
translations.이상 시: 지침이나 교육이 없으면 분해·전기·가스 정비를 시작하지 않아요: In case of abnormalities: Do not begin disassembly, electric, or gas maintenance without instructions or training.
translations.영업 영향과 안전 상태 확인: Check business impacts and safety conditions
translations.영업 중지 구역·대체 장비를 책임자와 정해요. 뜨거움·회전부가 멈추고 제:
Decide with the person in charge the area where business will be suspended and alternative equipment. Make sure that hot and rotating parts have stopped and are in a safe state according to the manufacturer's procedures.

Completion Criteria: Marked to prevent other crews from turning on the equipment they are working on.
In case of abnormality: If it cannot be stopped safely, leave it to maintenance personnel.
translations.누수·패킹·소음·필터 외관 점검: Inspect leakage, packing, noise, and filter appearance
translations.목록 순서대로 접근 가능한 부분을 보고 정상 사진·제조사 기준과 비교해요:
Look at the accessible parts in the list order and compare them with normal photo and manufacturer standards. Leave the name of the equipment, symptoms, conditions, and photos.

Completion criteria: Normal, action required, and discontinued use are classified by equipment.
In case of abnormality: Do not remove the protective cover or reach into the hazardous area to find the cause.
translations.허용된 청소 후 부품 복구와 작동 확인을 담당자와 수행해요. 미해결 문제:
After permitted cleaning, part recovery and operational verification are performed with the person in charge. Unresolved issues are left with a request number, responsibility, and deadline, and the next inspection date is updated.

Completion criteria: Recovery confirmation and unresolved items are separated.
In case of abnormality: Repair completion is not completed with just an inspection check.
If you find a food problem, foreign object, damage or a facility hazard, stop the affected work and food service. First ensure people are safe, then report the location, affected item, discovery time and situation to the person responsible.

Completion: The hazard area and affected orders have been identified.
translations.이상 시: 즉시 위험은 매장 비상 절차로 신고·대피하고 혼자 해결하려 하: In case of abnormalities: Immediately report and evacuate danger using store emergency procedures and do not attempt to solve the problem on your own.
translations.사용 보류 표시를 붙이고 동일 재료·배치·주문의 범위를 확인해요. 제품과:
Put a pending use sign and check the scope of the same material, batch, and order. Products, packaging, labels, and related records are preserved in a manner determined by the person in charge.

Completion criteria: No other crew is selling or using the pending item.
In case of abnormalities: Do not arbitrarily dispose of items that will serve as evidence or mix them with normal materials.
translations.관찰한 사실과 임시 조치 기록: Records of observations and interim actions
translations.누가 언제 무엇을 발견했는지, 관련 주문·수량·위치, 실제로 한 조치를:
Write down who discovered what and when, related orders, quantities, locations, and actual actions taken. Guest contact information is only kept on approved restricted access routes.

Completion criteria: Follow-up staff can understand without mixing facts with speculation.
In case of abnormalities: Do not post sensitive information in public notes or determine the cause.
translations.재개 승인과 다음 근무자 인계: Approval for resumption and handover to the next worker
Check the results of processing, recovery, disposal, and repair determined by the person in charge, as well as the scope of allowable resumption. The remaining inspection, contact information, and deadlines are passed on to the next worker.

Completion criteria: Distinguish between resumption approval and outstanding follow-up work.
translations.이상 시: 조치가 끝나지 않았으면 완료 체크로 정상 영업을 대신하지 않아: In case of an abnormality: If the action has not been completed, the completion check does not replace normal business.
translations.권한 있는 담당이 해당 영업일 POS 마감과 승인된 결제·취소·환불 기록:
An authorized person compares the POS closing date for the business day with the approved payment, cancellation, and refund records. Check your belongings after shift alert and midnight, and deposit cash at a designated location.

Completion criteria: There are differences in the amount depending on the payment method.
translations.이상 시: 금액이 다르면 기록을 맞추려고 임의 수정하지 말고 거래번호와: In case of abnormalities: If the amounts are different, do not arbitrarily modify the records to match them, but leave the transaction number and the difference.
translations.미결 주문·정산 차이 확인: Check the difference between open orders and settlement
translations.미결제·중복·부분 취소와 배달 채널별 정산 차이를 목록으로 만들어요. 주:
Make a list of non-payment, duplication, partial cancellation, and settlement differences by delivery channel. Write down the order number, amount, current status, and follow-up person.

Completion criteria: There are two types: normal closing and waiting for confirmation.
In case of abnormalities: Refunds and compensation follow the responsible authority and approval procedures.
translations.현금·자료·기기 보관: Storage of cash, data, and devices
translations.정해진 보관 경로로 현금과 마감 자료를 인계하고 승인된 기기에서 로그아웃:
Hand over cash and closing materials to designated storage routes and log out or lock them on approved devices. We do not leave printouts containing personal information unattended.

Completion criteria: Settlement data and cash receipt are confirmed.
In case of an abnormality: We do not arbitrarily process it by sharing a public password or transferring it to a personal account.
translations.품절·발주 미확정·예약·수리·미완료 업무를 대상·남은 행동·담당·기한으로:
Write down items such as out of stock, unconfirmed order, reservation, repair, and unfinished work by target, remaining action, responsibility, and deadline. Check whether it has been passed on to the next person in charge.

Completion criteria: Recipients immediately know what to do next.
In case of an abnormality: Cases where the person in charge has not been determined are not simply completed.
translations.고객 맞이·대기·좌석 안내: Greeting customers, waiting, and seating information
translations.눈을 맞추고 인사하기: Make eye contact and say hello
translations.손님이 들어오면 하던 안전 작업을 마무리하고 “어서 오세요. 몇 분이세요:
When a customer comes in, I finish the safety work I was doing and say “Welcome. How many people are there?” If it is difficult to guide you right away, let them know first by saying, “Please wait a moment. I will guide you shortly.”

Completion criteria: Visitors and guides confirmed.
translations.이상 시: 뜨거운 용기를 든 채 급하게 뛰지 않고 가까운 크루에게 응대를: In case of abnormalities: Instead of running quickly while holding a hot container, ask a nearby crew member to respond.
translations.예약 여부와 인원, 유아 의자·이동 편의가 필요한지 묻고 준비 가능한 좌:
We ask whether you have a reservation, the number of people, and whether you need a baby chair or transportation facilities, and check available seats. We do not guess a customer’s age, disability, or relationship based on their appearance.

Completion criteria: The reservation number matches the number of guests and the assistance needed has been confirmed.
In case of abnormalities: If there is no safe seat, check with the person in charge for alternative options.
translations.대기 시간과 순서 안내하기: Guidance on waiting time and order
After checking the actual vacancy and clearance status, we will guide you to the expected waiting time. Only the waiting names and number of people are recorded where necessary, and contact information is received through store approval.

Completion criteria: The guest understands the queue, expected time, and method of calling.
translations.이상 시: 예상보다 지연되면 먼저 변경된 상황을 알려요. 근거 없는 확정: In case of abnormalities: If it is delayed more than expected, we will notify you of the changed situation first. We do not promise unfounded fixed times.
translations.좌석까지 안내하고 첫 설명하기: Guide them to their seats and give an initial explanation.
translations.깨끗이 준비된 테이블 번호를 확인하고 메뉴·주문 방법·물 위치를 짧게 설:
Check the clearly prepared table number and briefly explain the menu, ordering method, and location of the water. “When ordering, please tell us if you have any allergies or ingredients to avoid.”

Completion criteria: Table number is correct and menu and ordering instructions provided.
translations.이상 시: 확인되지 않은 재료·가격·행사는 기억으로 답하지 않고 최신 매: In case of abnormalities: For unconfirmed ingredients, prices, and events, do not answer from memory but check the latest store data.
translations.고객의 질문을 끝까지 듣기: Listen to customer questions until the end
translations.메뉴 설명은 구성·맵기·양처럼 확인된 정보로 답해요. 추천은 “어떤 맛을:
Menu descriptions are answered with verified information such as composition, spiciness, and quantity. Recommendations start with “Which flavor do you prefer?” and if there is an additional cost, you will be notified before ordering.

Completion criteria: Understand the guest's menu selection and any additional costs.
translations.이상 시: 모르는 질문은 “정확히 확인하고 안내해 드리겠습니다”라고 말하: In case of a problem: If you have a question you don’t know, say, “I will check it clearly and guide you through it,” and confirm with the person in charge.
translations.매장명과 함께 전화 받기: Answer a call with the store name
translations.주변 소음을 줄이고 “안녕하세요, 우리 매장입니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?:
Reduce background noise and say clearly, “Hello, this is our store. How can I help you?” While on the phone, briefly excuse the other customer and make sure that no personal information is visible on the device screen.

Completion criteria: The type of customer inquiry and the person in charge of responding have been confirmed.
translations.이상 시: 받기 어려우면 책임자에게 연결해요. 가능하지 않은 자동 콜백을: In case of a problem: If it is difficult to receive, contact the person in charge. We do not promise automatic callbacks unless possible.
translations.보류·연결에 먼저 동의 구하기: Ask for consent to hold/connect first
translations.“확인을 위해 잠시 기다려 주실 수 있을까요?”라고 묻고 보류해요. 오래:
I put it on hold by asking, “Could you please wait a moment for confirmation?” If it takes a long time, we inform them of the interim situation and convey the customer's questions and confirmed details when connecting to another person in charge.

Completion criteria: Know who and what your customers are waiting for.
translations.이상 시: 연결이 안 되면 먼저 돌아와 가능한 회신 방법을 고객과 정해요: In case of abnormality: If connection is not possible, return first and discuss with the customer a possible reply method.
translations.예약 날짜·시간·인원 되읽기: Review reservation date, time, and number of people
translations.“10월 15일 목요일 저녁 7시, 네 분 예약이 맞으실까요?”처럼 날짜:
Read back the date, weekday, a.m./p.m., party size and reservation name, for example: “May I confirm a reservation for four people on Thursday, 10/15, at 7 p.m.?” Explain seat availability and the store’s approved rules for changing or cancelling reservations.

Completion: The same information is recorded on the reservation sheet and confirmed by the customer.
translations.이상 시: 만석이면 확정이라고 말하지 않고 가능한 시간 또는 대기 방식을: In case of abnormalities: If all seats are full, we do not say it is confirmed but suggest a possible time or waiting method.
translations.포장 메뉴·옵션·수령 시간 확인하기: Check packaging menu, options, and pickup time
translations.메뉴명·수량·옵션·제외 재료·포장 여부를 한 항목씩 적고 주방에 실제 준:
Write down the menu name, quantity, options, excluded ingredients, and packaging items one by one and check the actual preparation time with the kitchen. Allergy requests will be notified after confirming with the person responsible for the possibility of cross-contact with the raw materials.

Completion criteria: Kitchen and customer confirmed identical order and preparation times.
translations.이상 시: 안전 여부가 불확실하면 가능하다고 약속하지 않고 대안 또는 제: In case of abnormalities: If safety is uncertain, we do not promise that it is possible, but instead inform you of alternatives or unavailability.
translations.금액·수령 방법을 마지막으로 확인하기: Final confirmation of amount and method of receipt
translations.최신 가격표로 총액과 결제 방법을 안내하고 “주문은 …, 수령은 …시,:
The latest price list provides the total amount and payment method, and reads back, “The order is…, the pickup is at…, and the amount is…won. Is that correct?” For directions, use the actual address and entrance information.

Completion criteria: Recipient, receipt time, and confirmed request left on the order sheet.
translations.이상 시: 주문 변경은 주방 접수 여부를 확인하고 변경 내용이 전달됐는지: In case of an abnormality: For order changes, check whether the kitchen has received them and check again whether the changes have been delivered.
translations.통화 종료와 개인정보 정리하기: Ending calls and organizing personal information
translations.“문의 감사합니다. 방문 때 뵙겠습니다”라고 마무리한 뒤 예약 또는 주문:
Conclude with “Thank you for your inquiry. I’ll see you when I visit,” and then connect the reservation or order record to the crew in charge. I do not transfer contacts to personal messengers or personal devices.

Completion criteria: The call is linked to work records and no unnecessary notes are left.
translations.이상 시: 부재 문의는 확인할 담당과 회신 약속을 남기되 실제로 연결되지: In case of abnormalities: For absence inquiries, leave an appointment with the person in charge to check, but do not say that you have actually sent a notification that was not connected.
translations.테이블과 메뉴를 한 번 더 확인: Check the table and menu one more time
translations.테이블 번호를 먼저 확인하고 메뉴·수량·옵션·제외 요청을 주문 기기에 입:
Check the table number first and enter menu, quantity, options, and exclusion requests into the ordering machine. Rather than guessing what the customer is saying and completing it midway, read it back and then send it.

Completion criteria: The delivery details are the same as the order confirmed by the customer.
translations.이상 시: 주문표가 출력되지 않으면 중복 전송 전에 주방 수신 여부를 확: In case of abnormality: If the order sheet is not printed, check whether the kitchen has received it before sending a duplicate.
translations.품절은 대안과 가격 차이까지 안내: When out of stock, we inform you of the price difference between alternatives.
translations.주방과 품절·재개 가능 시점을 확인하고 주문 전에 알려요. 대체 메뉴의:
We check with the kitchen and when it is sold out or can be reopened and let you know before ordering. We explain the composition and additional costs of the alternative menu and only change the items that the customer agrees to.

Completion criteria: Out of stock notification and alternative selection reflected in order sheet.
In case of abnormalities: We do not arbitrarily promise combinations or prices that are not on the store menu.
translations.추가·취소는 조리 상태 먼저 확인: To add or cancel, check the cooking status first.
translations.고객 요청을 적고 주방에 현재 진행 단계를 확인해요. 변경 가능 여부와:
Write down customer requests and check the current progress with the kitchen. After explaining whether changes can be made and the difference in price, make the changes in the approved manner and see if the revision slip has been sent to the kitchen.

Completion criteria: Existing and modified orders are distinguished and there is no duplicate cooking.
In case of an abnormality: Orders that have already been prepared will be notified to the responsible person for changes or refunds.
translations.지연을 먼저 알리고 다시 약속: Announce the delay first and re-promise
Check the current order sequence and the kitchen's estimated time and explain, "Preparation is running late. It will take about... minutes longer." If possible, we present alternatives that customers can choose from.

Completion criteria: Confirmed time estimates and alternatives have been communicated to the customer.
In case of an abnormality: If the expectations change again, do not make them wait, but inform them first.
translations.불만·오주문·환불 요청 응대: Responding to complaints, incorrect orders, and refund requests
translations.말을 끊지 않고 듣고 “불편을 드려 죄송합니다. 주문하신 내용과 제공된:
Listen without interrupting and say, “We apologize for the inconvenience. We will check what you ordered and what was provided.” We do not argue in front of other guests.

Completion criteria: A distinction has been made between the solution requested by the customer and the actual occurrence.
translations.이상 시: 위협·폭력이 있으면 동료·책임자에게 도움을 요청하고 안전한 거: In case of abnormalities: If there is a threat or violence, ask a colleague or person in charge for help and keep a safe distance.
translations.주문·제공·결제 사실 대조: Comparison of order, provision, and payment facts
translations.테이블·주문 시각·메뉴·결제 내역을 확인해요. 음식이나 물품은 고객 동의:
Check table, order time, menu, and payment details. Food and items are stored separately with customer consent, and we do not assume someone is at fault before confirming the cause.

Completion criteria: I have communicated what I have confirmed and what I do not yet know to the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 이물·신체 이상 등은 제공을 중지하고 책임자에게 즉시 연결해요: In case of abnormality: If there is a foreign object or body abnormality, stop providing it and immediately contact the person in charge.
translations.책임자에게 재제공·교환·환불 가능 여부를 확인하고 고객에게 가능한 선택과:
Check with the person in charge whether resupply, exchange, or refund is possible and explain the available options and expected time to the customer. We only promise to provide discounts or freebies within the approved range.

Completion criteria: Customer and approval team have confirmed identical resolution.
translations.이상 시: 거절 안내가 필요하면 이유를 짧게 설명하고 책임자 응대로 연결: In case of an abnormality: If rejection is required, briefly explain the reason and contact the person in charge.
translations.해결 결과와 다음 조치 남기기: Leave a resolution and next action
translations.약속한 재제공·결제 취소가 실제로 처리됐는지 확인하고 고객에게 다시 알려:
We check whether the promised re-provision and payment cancellation have actually been processed and notify the customer again. Write down the details of the occurrence, actions taken, responsibility, and points to prevent recurrence in the handover.

Completion criteria: Distinguish between processing results and unfinished follow-up tasks.
translations.이상 시: 결제 취소 실패는 완료로 말하지 않고 실제 상태와 담당을 알려: In case of abnormalities: Payment cancellation failure is not indicated as complete, but the actual status and responsibility are notified.
translations.알레르기 요청 확인과 주방 전달: Allergy request confirmation and kitchen delivery
translations.피해야 하는 재료를 정확히 묻기: Ask exactly what ingredients to avoid
translations.알레르기 요청을 받으면 대상 재료와 주문 메뉴를 기록해요. “해당 재료와:
When I receive an allergy request, I record the target ingredients and order menu. Say, “I will confirm the ingredients and cooking process with the person in charge and then provide guidance.”

Completion criteria: Customer request is clearly recorded on order sheet.
translations.이상 시: 알레르기의 심각도를 크루가 판단하거나 조금은 괜찮다고 권하지: In case of abnormalities: The crew does not judge the severity of the allergy or recommend that it is slightly okay.
translations.원재료 자료와 조리 환경 확인: Check raw material data and cooking environment
translations.소스·토핑·대체 재료까지 최신 원재료 자료를 확인하고 주방 책임자에게 공:
Check the latest raw material data, including sauces, toppings, and substitute ingredients, and ask the kitchen manager about the possibility of cross-contact with shared tools, oil, and work surfaces.

Completion criteria: The person in charge has reviewed the confirmed ingredients and whether they can be cooked.
translations.이상 시: 정보가 없거나 안전을 확인할 수 없으면 제공 가능하다고 말하지: In case of abnormalities: If there is no information or safety cannot be confirmed, it will not be said that it can be provided.
translations.고객 확인 후 주문을 구분해 전달: After customer confirmation, orders are sorted and delivered
translations.확인 결과와 제한을 고객에게 설명하고 선택한 주문을 주방 담당에게 말과:
The confirmation results and restrictions are explained to the customer, and the selected order is communicated to the kitchen manager verbally and on an order form. Just before serving, we compare the order with the target table again.

Completion criteria: Kitchen staff and serving crew confirmed identical requests.
translations.이상 시: 실수나 혼입 가능성이 있으면 해당 접시 제공을 멈추고 책임자: In case of abnormalities: If there is a possibility of a mistake or mix-up, the serving of the dish in question will be stopped and the person responsible will be judged.
translations.반복된 불편과 미완료 업무 찾기: Finding repeated inconveniences and unfinished tasks
translations.지난달 인계·불만·업무 이상 기록에서 반복된 주제를 추려요. 빈도뿐 아니:
Let’s pick out recurring themes from last month’s records of handovers, complaints, and work abnormalities. In addition to frequency, we prioritize items that have significant safety, customer impact, and rework.

Completion criteria: The items and reasons for change this time have been organized.
translations.이상 시: 기록이 없으면 발생했다고 가정하지 말고 크루에게 사례를 확인해: In case of an abnormality: If there is no record, do not assume it occurred and check with the crew about the case.
translations.메뉴·가격·전화 안내 대조: Comparison of menus, prices, and phone information
translations.현재 메뉴·가격·품절 안내·예약 방식·연락처를 실제 사용하는 자료와 대조:
Compare the current menu, price, out-of-stock information, reservation method, and contact information with data actually used. Edit or store unused guidance.

Completion criteria: Instructions provided to customers are consistent with current store operations.
In case of abnormalities: Any changes in price or refund authority will be notified after confirmation by the manager.
translations.정기 점검·소모품·설비 일정 확인: Check regular inspection, consumables, and equipment schedules
translations.설비별 제조사 점검 권장 주기와 매장 기록을 대조해 다음 점검일·업체 연:
Check the next inspection date, company contact, and person in charge by comparing the manufacturer's recommended inspection cycle for each facility with store records. It does not replace routine cleaning that requires monthly inspection.

Completion criteria: Inspection schedule, responsibility, and necessary preparations have been organized.
translations.이상 시: 고장 징후는 정기일까지 미루지 말고 사용 중지와 책임자 보고를: In case of abnormalities: Do not postpone signs of malfunction until a regular date. Stop using the product and report it to the person responsible first.
translations.변경할 매뉴얼과 반복 업무 검토: Review manuals and repetitive tasks for changes
translations.사장님이 매뉴얼의 행동·완료 기준·이상 대응을 수정하고 내일 미리보기에서:
The boss revises the manual's actions, completion criteria, and response to abnormalities and checks the responsible department and schedule in tomorrow's preview. Explain to the crew the reason for the change and the effective date.

Completion criteria: Confirmed revisions and scope of future application.
In case of an abnormality: Records of work already in progress and completed are not overwritten with new standards.
translations.20석 규모의 뼈찜 식당을 가정한 운영 본보기입니다. 매장 기준 → 폴더:
This is an operation example assuming a 20-seat bone jjim restaurant.
Store standard → folder → TAP → core action → detailed method were organized in the same context.
translations.실제 매장의 운영 기록이 아닙니다. 배합·수량·시간은 구조를 보여주는 예:
This is not a record of actual store operations.
Mixture, quantity, and time are examples of structure and require confirmation of our store’s products, equipment, processes, and personnel.
translations.뼈찜·국물 메뉴, 홀 식사·포장, 이미 채용된 크루: Bone stew/soup menu, whole meal/takeaway, crew already hired
translations.가열 공정과 완성 품질 확인: Check heating process and finished quality
translations.홀 준비·고객 요청·포장 인계: Hall preparation, customer request, packaging handover
translations.홀 출입구 오른쪽. 사용 식기는 여기서 잔반 분류 후 세척 구역으로 이동:
To the right of the hall entrance.
Used dishes are sorted here and then moved to the washing area.
translations.반납대 옆. 음식물·일반·재활용 통을 서로 구별:
Next to the return desk.
Distinguish between food, general and recycling bins
translations.주방 왼쪽 벽. 반납 식기와 깨끗한 식기의 이동을 교차시키지 않음:
Left wall of the kitchen.
Do not intersect the movement of returned and clean dishes
translations.세척대 뒤쪽. 확인되지 않은 식기는 완성 식기 칸에 두지 않음:
Behind the washing machine.
Do not place unidentified utensils in the finished utensil compartment.
translations.주방 중앙 P-01. 날재료 도구와 완성 음식 도구를 구별:
Kitchen center P-01.
Distinguish between raw food utensils and finished food utensils
translations.주방 오른쪽 C-01. 사용 안내와 권한을 확인한 크루만 조작:
C-01 on the right side of the kitchen.
Operated only by crew members who have confirmed usage instructions and permissions
translations.주방 뒤쪽 R-01/R-02. 제품 상태별 칸과 실제 보관 기준을 표시:
R-01/R-02 behind the kitchen.
Displays columns for each product status and actual storage standards
translations.홀 인계창 앞 K-01. 주문별 트레이 한 개를 사용:
K-01 in front of the hall transfer window.
Use one tray per order
translations.세척대 맞은편 S-01. 용도와 제품 표시를 읽고 선택:
S-01 across from the washing station.
Read the intended use and product labeling before making your choice
translations.영업·브레이크·포장 안내가 만나는 위치: Location where sales, breaks, and packaging information meet
translations.가상 배치 · 4석 설정 용량이며 현재 손님 수가 아님: Virtual layout · 4 seating capacity, not current number of guests
translations.예시 배합과 업무 목표량은 도입할 때 실제 제품·판매량·장비로 다시 확인: When introducing example formulations and business targets, check again with actual products, sales volume, and equipment.
translations.제품 표시와 검토된 매장 기준 사용. 모르는 온도·시간·보관기한을 임의로:
Product labeling and use of reviewed store standards.
Do not arbitrarily write down unknown temperature, time, or storage period.
translations.읽기·넘기기는 완료가 아님. 수행·측정·문제 조치 후 핵심 행동만 확인:
Reading and skipping are not complete.
Confirm only key actions after performing, measuring, and resolving issues
translations.처음 안내 후 버디와 함께 연습. 본인 수행과 버디 확인을 구별:
After initial guidance, practice with a buddy.
Distinguish between self-performing and buddy checking
translations.발주는 재고 증가가 아님. 받은 양만 입고하며 중간 확인은 마지막 발주:
Ordering is not an increase in inventory.
Only the received quantity is stocked, and interim confirmation is not delayed after the final order.
Example Monday · Open preparation and sales, 1 preparation batch, break, closing.
Receipt confirmation will not be created as a new daily check if there is no actual receipt
translations.기준·등록·설정 변경 확인: Confirm changes to standards, registration, and settings
translations.권한 범위의 이상 조치와 현장 확인: Abnormal actions within the scope of authority and on-site confirmation
translations.개업 전 · 영업 조건과 준비 서류: Before opening · Operating requirements and documents
translations.계약·공사 전에 영업 가능 조건 확인: Check operating conditions before signing or construction
translations.판매 방식과 취급 품목, 주소와 시설 계획을 적고 관할 기관에 해당 업종:
Write down the sales format, products, address and facility plans. Ask the responsible authority which notifications, permits and facility requirements apply. Do not assume the previous operator’s permission transfers unchanged.

Done when: the authority, date, response, outstanding conditions, responsible person and deadline are recorded.
translations.위생교육·건강진단 대상과 일정 확인: Check hygiene training and health examination requirements
translations.영업자와 식품을 직접 취급할 크루의 업무를 나누고 적용되는 교육·건강진단:
Separate the operator’s duties from those of crew handling food directly. Check official guidance for applicable training, health examinations and preparation before opening. Keep documents containing personal data out of shared manuals.

Done when: each person’s verification owner, readiness, document location and review schedule are defined.
translations.제출·발급·승인 상태를 구분: Distinguish submitted, issued and approved documents
translations.신고·등록·검사·보험 등 우리 매장에 해당하는 절차를 목록으로 만들고 접:
List the notifications, registrations, inspections and insurance procedures that apply to your store. Separate submission from completion. Confirm originals, copies, fees and contacts with the responsible person and plan backwards from opening day.

Done when: the person in charge can see whether conditions required before trading remain unresolved.
translations.개업 준비 문서의 담당과 접근 범위 정리: Assign document owners and access levels
translations.사업·임대·설비·거래처·비상 연락 자료의 원본 보관 장소와 수정 담당을:
Choose where originals of business, lease, equipment, supplier and emergency contact records are kept and who updates them. Share only the locations and contact routes crew need; keep personal documents and passwords separate.

Done when: essential contacts can be found without the owner present, while sensitive records remain restricted.
translations.개업 전 · 공간·설비와 작업 동선: Before opening · Premises, equipment and workflow
translations.입고부터 폐기까지 실제 동선 걸어보기: Walk the actual route from receiving to waste removal
translations.입고·보관·전처리·조리·제공·반납·세척·건조·폐기 장소를 실제 바닥에서:
Locate receiving, storage, preparation, cooking, service, returns, washing, drying and waste areas on site. Find where clean and used dishes, or ingredients and waste, cross; adjust locations or movement times.

Done when: every place has a name and photo, with no temporary storage blocking aisles or exits.
translations.설비별 사용·종료·고장 대응 기준 등록: Register equipment use, shutdown and fault procedures
translations.모델명과 제조사 설명서, 설치·점검 업체 연락처를 모아요. 사용 가능한:
Gather model numbers, manufacturer instructions and installer or service contacts. Define authorized users, normal indicators, shutdown procedures and equipment that stays running. Confirm breaker and valve locations with the responsible person; do not test them arbitrarily.

Done when: new crew can find pre-use guidance and the fault-reporting contact.
translations.첫 영업 전 청소·급배수·보관 상태 검수: Inspect cleaning, water, drainage and storage before first service
Remove building debris and dust, then assign cleaning tools and product instructions by area. Check handwashing facilities, water, drainage, waste locations and storage equipment for operation and cleanliness. Resolve leaks, pest signs and unsuitable storage conditions first.

Done when: the responsible person has checked actual operation and restricted areas are marked out of use.
translations.영업 종료와 비상 상황을 현장에서 연습: Practise shutdown and emergency responses on site
translations.상시 가동할 보관 장비와 종료할 조명·열원 목록을 구분해 마감 경로를 걸:
Walk the closing route, distinguishing storage equipment that must keep running from lighting and heat sources to turn off. Share evacuation routes, emergency contacts and how to stop and report faults. Do not create real hazards for practice.

Done when: the final checker and their substitute can explain the same shutdown criteria.
translations.개업 전 · 판매 메뉴와 고객 안내 기준: Before opening · Menu and customer information standards
translations.판매할 메뉴의 레시피와 원가 기준 확정: Confirm recipes and costing for the menu
translations.메뉴별 재료·규격·분량·공정·완성 사진·제공 구성을 레시피에 모아요. 실:
Keep ingredients, specifications, quantities, process, finished photos and serving contents in each recipe. Check costs using actual trial yields, losses and packaging; the responsible person sets selling prices. Do not start sales using unverified example values.

Done when: different cooks have a common comparison standard and an identified editor.
translations.메뉴판·주문 화면·포장 안내 대조: Compare menus, order screens and takeaway information
translations.판매 이름·가격·옵션·품절·포장비·주문 마감 안내를 사용하는 모든 주문:
Compare item names, prices, options, availability, packaging fees and last-order notices across every channel you use. Read customer information alongside the kitchen ticket to check they mean the same thing. Exclude channels you do not operate.

Done when: price differences and missing options are corrected and all places needing coordinated updates are listed.
translations.원재료·대체품과 알레르기 질문 경로 준비: Prepare ingredient records and an allergy enquiry route
translations.복합 원재료와 소스까지 제품 표시를 확인하고 메뉴별 자료를 연결해요. 대:
Check product labels, including compound ingredients and sauces, and link records to menus. Require a new check whenever a substitute arrives. Practise wording and escalation so crew do not guess answers to allergy questions.

Done when: everyone understands that unverified requests must not be promised as safe to fulfil.
translations.시험 주문·변경·취소·수령까지 왕복 확인: Test ordering, changes, cancellation and collection end to end
translations.시험임을 알리고 주문 접수부터 주방 전달, 제공·포장, 결제와 취소까지:
Announce the test, then check order entry, kitchen delivery, serving or packing, payment and cancellation. Obtain the responsible person’s approval before any test needing a real payment, and verify the cancellation outcome. Record lost or duplicated order numbers.

Done when: test records are separated from real sales and stock, and unresolved errors have an owner.
translations.개업 전 · 거래처·첫 발주와 재고 기준: Before opening · Suppliers, first orders and stock standards
translations.거래처와 품목별 납품 조건 합의: Agree supplier and product delivery conditions
translations.품명·규격·단위·포장·보관 조건·납품 요일·주문 마감·최소 수량을 확인해:
Confirm product name, specification, unit, packaging, storage conditions, delivery days, order cutoff and minimum quantity. Record holiday or shortage contacts, substitute approval and handling of defects, missing items and returns. Recheck verbal promises with the responsible person.

Done when: different purchasers can order the same specification under the same conditions.
translations.첫 발주량을 보관 능력과 시험 결과로 계산: Calculate first orders using storage capacity and trial results
translations.예상 판매량을 확정 수요로 보지 말고 시험 조리 소모량, 납품 간격, 실:
Treat forecast sales as estimates. Check trial ingredient use, delivery intervals and actual storage capacity together. Record required quantities and their basis, then obtain approval for the first order.

Done when: there is room for the order and someone is responsible for adjusting surpluses or shortages.
translations.첫 입고를 검수하고 실제 시작 재고 기록: Inspect the first delivery and record actual opening stock
translations.주문과 실물을 대조해 정상 입고·보류·반품·미입고를 나눠요. 기한과 제품:
Compare orders with goods; separate accepted, held, returned and undelivered quantities. Check dates and product-specific acceptance criteria. Store and record only accepted quantities actually received. An order alone does not increase stock.

Done when: quantity, unit, location and supplier records can be checked against the physical goods.
translations.보관 표시·사용 순서와 확인 주기 정하기: Define storage labels, use order and checking dates
translations.제품 상태별 보관 위치, 개봉·소분 표시와 매장 사용 기준을 정해요. 사:
Set storage locations by product state, opening or portioning labels and store use criteria. Hold items with unknown handling history separately. Distinguish the post-order stock-check deadline from receipt processing; an interim check must not postpone that deadline.

Done when: the next person knows which items to use first and when to check them.
translations.개업 전 · 파트 배분과 크루 첫 연습: Before opening · Roles and first crew practice
translations.파트·직책·대체 담당을 따로 정하기: Define parts, ranks and substitute coverage separately
translations.조리·준비·설거지·홀·포장·관리 역할별로 할 일과 넘겨받을 결과를 적어요:
For cooking, preparation, dishwashing, service, packing and management, list tasks and handover results. Parts classify work; ranks determine change permissions. Identify combined roles and who covers absences.

Done when: peak periods leave no hidden gaps and the help contact is clear.
translations.영업시간과 준비·마감·교대 시간 맞추기: Align trading, preparation, closing and shift times
translations.고객 영업시간과 크루의 준비·마감 시간을 구별하고 파트별 필요 인원, 교:
Separate customer trading hours from crew preparation and closing time. Match staffing needs, shift changes and breaks to the actual roster. Keep one-off opening preparation separate from daily opening checks.

Done when: coverage and gaps are visible by time, and the owner has decided how to cover shortages.
translations.버디 시범·직접 연습·확인을 분리: Separate buddy demonstration, practice and confirmation
translations.버디가 장소와 방법을 보여주고 새 크루가 직접 해본 뒤 완료 기준을 설명:
The buddy shows the place and method; the new crew member tries it and explains the completion criteria. Encourage questions and mark equipment or tasks that should not yet be done alone. Reading a guide does not complete real work.

Done when: personal practice and buddy confirmation are distinct, with further practice items recorded.
translations.매장 기준을 수정한 뒤 실제 업무 연결: Adapt store standards before connecting live work
translations.사장님이 예제의 장소·도구·수량·표현을 실제 매장에 맞춰 고쳐요. 루틴은:
The owner adapts example places, tools, quantities and wording to the real store. Check people and timing for routines, intervals for periodic work and reference paths for recipes, then register chosen content. Check important changes and translations for needed languages.

Done when: new crew can start using the guide and unsettled standards remain clearly on hold.
translations.개업 전 · 가오픈과 최종 준비 확인: Before opening · Trial service and final readiness
translations.손님 입장부터 마감까지 시험 운영: Run a trial from customer arrival through closing
translations.시험 손님 역할과 담당을 정하고 입장·대기·주문·조리·제공·결제·퇴석·정:
Assign trial customers and crew roles, then follow the actual route through arrival, waiting, ordering, cooking, serving, payment, departure and reset. Record waits, missing tools and repeated questions; choose manageable improvements.

Done when: every issue found on site has a location, owner and correction deadline.
translations.동시 주문·품절·교대를 함께 연습: Practise overlapping orders, shortages and handovers
translations.가능한 주문량 안에서 주문이 겹치는 상황과 품절·변경·포장 수령·교대를:
Within manageable capacity, test overlapping orders, unavailable items, changes, pickup and shift changes. Practise kitchen and service read-back through confirmation by the receiving colleague. Do not record unhandled demand as proven capacity.

Done when: the person controlling order intake and customer communication rules during rushes are clear.
translations.고장·미입고·결원 때의 대안 확인: Check alternatives for breakdowns, missed deliveries and absences
translations.장비 고장, 주문 시스템 중단, 미입고, 크루 부재를 가정해 멈출 범위와:
Talk through equipment failure, ordering-system outage, missing deliveries and crew absence. Define what stops and whom to contact. Do not substitute equipment or ingredients whose safety is unverified.

Done when: responsibility and communication routes for reduced service, stopping sales and restarting are clear.
translations.개업 가능 여부와 미완료 항목 최종 검토: Review opening readiness and unfinished items
translations.사장님이 서류·설비·위생·판매·입고·인원·연습 결과를 직접 대조해요. 영:
The owner checks documents, facilities, hygiene, sales setup, deliveries, staffing and trial results personally. Separate issues preventing opening from improvements for later; specify restricted areas and menu items. Share changed standards with an owner and effective date.

Done when: checks have named reviewers, and unverified items are not marked complete.
Check your store standards and the person responsible before using this guide.
translations.반납대 사진과 매장 표기를 확인해 큰 접시·작은 접시·그릇·컵·수저를 각: Check the return station photo and store labels, then sort large plates, small plates, bowls, cups and cutlery into their designated areas. Washing methods may vary by shape or material; ask the person responsible about unfamiliar items. Keep cracked or chipped dishes separate from usable ones and report them following store procedures. Done when: you have checked each return location and separated mixed dishes.
translations.예시를 매장 식기 종류와 실제 반납대 칸 이름으로 수정하고 장소 사진을: Replace the example with your store's dish types and actual return-station section names, and add a location photo.
translations.잔반은 지정된 통에 버리기: Put leftovers in the designated bin
translations.세척대로 옮기기 전에 식기에 남은 음식을 연결된 잔반통에 제거해요. 포장: Before moving dishes to the washing area, remove leftover food into the linked food-waste bin. Separate packaging, tissues, toothpicks and other items according to store rules. Do not push food or solid waste into the sink drain. Ask the person responsible if you are unsure of the waste category. Done when: food and other waste are in their designated locations and no solids have entered the drain.
translations.통의 실제 위치와 버릴 수 있는 음식·이물질 구분을 매장 기준으로 기재하: Specify the actual bin location and which food and other waste it accepts according to store rules.
translations.세척 전 지정된 거름망이 제자리에 있는지, 잔반이 쌓여 있는지, 물이 정: Before washing, check that the designated strainer is in place, whether food waste has accumulated, and whether water drains normally. Follow the store procedures you were shown for cleaning the strainer and using detergent and equipment. If drainage is poor or abnormal, stop using the area, record the task as blocked and inform the person responsible. Done when: you have checked the strainer and drainage; if there is a problem, do not mark the task complete before confirming corrective action.
translations.세제 희석·세척 온도·장비 조작은 제품 안내와 검수된 매장 기준으로 추가: Add detergent dilution, washing temperature and equipment instructions from the product guidance and reviewed store standards.
translations.세척한 식기를 지정된 건조 칸에 놓기: Place washed dishes in their designated drying sections
translations.세척 결과를 확인한 뒤 연결된 건조대 사진과 표기를 보고 큰 접시·작은: Check the washing result, then use the linked drying-rack photo and labels to place large plates, small plates, bowls, cups and cutlery in their designated sections. This example does not describe your actual shelves. Keep unwashed and washed dishes separate and follow the store's drying and storage standards. Done when: you have checked the drying location for each dish type and no dirty dishes are mixed in.
translations.예: 큰 접시 아래 칸/작은 접시 가운데 칸/컵·수저 전용 구역. 실제: Example: large plates on the bottom shelf, small plates in the middle, and a dedicated area for cups and cutlery. Check and adapt this to your actual store.
translations.다음 교대에 남은 일과 이상 전달하기: Pass remaining work and problems to the next shift
translations.세척 대기 식기, 잔반통 상태, 세제·도구 부족, 배수 이상과 조치 상황: Review waiting dishes, the food-waste bin, shortages of detergent or tools, drainage problems and actions taken with the next person responsible. Keep unresolved blocked tasks in the issue record; do not check them off as resolved. Done when: you have passed on the remaining work and points needing attention.
Link this to the actual shift-change time in the roster; do not check it off for every dish.
